若是有人能够解答使你抓心挠肝的那些问题，那准是《黄衣之王》的演职人员了。眼下没有其他的线索可以追寻，你穿上你最光鲜的衣装，前往大西洋街1452号，一位名叫康斯坦丝·杜梅因的女士将在那儿举办庆功宴会，庆祝这部戏剧在阿卡姆城成功上演。

presentation.title: 故事导入
presentation.name: 发掘真相
presentation.text: 若是有人能够解答使你抓心挠肝的那些问题，那准是《黄衣之王》的演职人员了。眼下没有其他的线索可以追寻，你穿上你最光鲜的衣装，前往大西洋街1452号，一位名叫康斯坦丝·杜梅因的女士将在那儿举办庆功宴会，庆祝这部戏剧在阿卡姆城成功上演。

events.text: 初始密谋：礼节性迟到。

presentation.title: 密谋揭示
presentation.name: 礼节性迟到
presentation.text: 新的威胁正在逼近。

events.text: 收齐“最后的王者、哈斯塔的馈赠、衰败与污秽、陌生人、远古恶魔”遭遇组。布置六个地点，调查员从门厅开始。将五名旁人随机放到其余地点，每人带有调查员数量加1个线索；将黛安娜·迪瓦恩放在一边，并把五张“令人作呕的现实”放在冒险参考卡下。
🔮 黛安娜·史丹利 位于「门厅」。
🛡️ 罗兰·班克斯 位于「门厅」。
📖 乔·戴蒙德 位于「门厅」。
☀️ 第 1 回合 · 调查阶段开始，轮到 黛安娜·史丹利。
🔮 乔·戴蒙德 揭示直觉牌库顶的「指导」：本阶段可以少付 2 资源打出它。

1.objective: 为下一关《最后的国王》补足罗兰的心智防护
1.intent: 结束本席位操作，进入下一关
1.upgrade: XP积累后再考虑换入更强的心智防护卡
1.reason: 当前0经验、升级暂存为空，塞维尔已在牌组中，无需再买

scenarioCheckpoints.scenarioName: 卡尔克萨之路 · 往事回声

scenario.name: 卡尔克萨之路 · 往事回声
scenario.intro: 你们来到阿卡姆历史协会，寻找早年《黄衣之王》演出留下的记录。
scenario.setup: 每层随机移出一个历史协会地点，布置入口大厅、两张宁静的走廊和其余六个地点。将隐藏的图书馆、附身宣誓者、皮博迪先生、褴褛披风和黑玛瑙扣环放在一边。

entryHall.name: 入口大厅
entryHall.text:
入口大厅与其他每个[[一楼]]地点连接。
[action]：撤退。你逃走了，把过去的谜团留给那些神秘的异教徒。

meetingRoom.name: 历史协会
meetingRoom.text: [action]横置一个[[盟友]]支援：发现本地点的1个线索。(每轮仅限一次。)
meetingRoom.flavor: 一把椅子打翻在地，天花板上破了一个窟窿。是谁搞的破坏？

groundRecordOffice.name: 历史协会
groundRecordOffice.text: 位于本地点的每个敌人得到+1攻击与+1躲避。
groundRecordOffice.flavor: 这间狭小的房间里堆满了无数文件，本来这些能帮你进行有效调查，可惜文件柜抽屉里塞满了黏稠，恶臭的烂泥。

groundMuseum.name: 历史协会
groundMuseum.text: 调查本地点时，不能提升你的[intellect]。(FAQ，v1.2)
groundMuseum.flavor: 这里的大部分展品都来自于18世纪早期，它们见证了阿卡姆殖民时代和它开埠的早期历史。

quietHallsSecond.name: 宁静的走廊
quietHallsSecond.text:
宁静的走廊与其他每个[[二楼]]地点连接。
[action]如果场上每个地点均已揭示，且场上所有地点上均没有线索：在宁静的走廊上放置1[per_investigator]个线索(从供应堆拿取)。

secondMuseum.name: 历史协会
secondMuseum.text: 调查本地点时，不能提升你的[intellect]。(FAQ，v1.2)
secondMuseum.flavor: 这里的大部分展品都来自于18世纪早期，它们见证了阿卡姆殖民时代和它开埠的早期历史。

secondLibrary.name: 历史协会
secondLibrary.text: [reaction]你成功调查本地点后，受到2点恐惧：发现本地点的1个线索。(每轮仅限一次。)
secondLibrary.flavor: 光是看到历史图书馆里书本的数量就能让人吃惊不已。即便你在这里泡上几个星期，也不可能把它们都整理归档。

readingRoom.name: 历史协会
readingRoom.text: [action]：调查。如果你检定成功，不发现线索，改为选择一个有毁灭标记的敌人。拿取该敌人上的1个毁灭标记，将其翻至线索面，并将其放置到你的调查员上。(团队每轮仅限一次。)
readingRoom.flavor: 从摇曳的灯光和翻开的书本看得出，最近有人在这里阅读。

quietHallsThird.name: 宁静的走廊
quietHallsThird.text:
宁静的走廊与其他每个[[三楼]]地点连接。
[action]如果场上每个地点均已揭示，且场上所有地点上均没有线索：在宁静的走廊上放置1[per_investigator]个线索(从供应堆拿取)。

thirdLibrary.name: 历史协会
thirdLibrary.text: [reaction]你成功调查本地点后，受到2点恐惧：发现本地点的1个线索。(每轮仅限一次。)
thirdLibrary.flavor: 光是看到历史图书馆里书本的数量就能让人吃惊不已。即便你在这里泡上几个星期，也不可能把它们都整理归档。

peabodysOffice.name: 历史协会
peabodysOffice.text: 位于本地点的调查员控制皮博迪先生时，本地点隐藏值-2。
peabodysOffice.flavor: 这间办公室的主人一定是历史协会里的重要人物。

thirdRecordOffice.name: 历史协会
thirdRecordOffice.text: 位于本地点的每个敌人得到+1攻击与+1躲避。
thirdRecordOffice.flavor: 这间狭小的房间里堆满了无数文件，本来这些能帮你进行有效调查，可惜文件柜抽屉里塞满了黏稠，恶臭的烂泥。

hiddenLibrary.name: 隐藏的图书馆
hiddenLibrary.text: 敌人移动时，隐藏的图书馆获得[[通道]]特性。
hiddenLibrary.flavor: 这间狭小的阅览室里到处结着蜘蛛网，地板铺着厚厚一层灰尘。房间四周的书架上堆满了书本。但地上还散落着几本书，似乎是借阅者匆忙间落下的。丽莎·法雷尔，《诡镇奇谈的调查员们》

acts.name: 追寻答案
acts.flavor: 历史协会里房间众多，每一间都保存着大量记录和文档，也许能有助于你寻找关于《黄衣之王》的答案。这里一定有什么东西能指引你获得真相。
acts.advanceText: 在每个已揭示的历史协会地点上放置1[per_investigator]个线索(上限为其本身线索值)。

acts.name: 昔日恶果
acts.flavor: 这幢宅邸内有一个“隐藏的图书馆”，也许你能在其中找到有关《黄衣之王》的更多信息。如果要继续调查，你就必须找到进去的方法。
acts.advanceText:
在每个已揭示的历史协会地点上放置1[per_investigator]个线索(上限为其本身线索值)。
选择一位调查员控制放在一边的皮博迪先生支援。
将放在一边的隐藏的图书馆地点放置入场。

acts.name: 誓约
acts.text:
带有[[通道]]特性的地点互相连接。
目标 - 只有在隐藏的图书馆的调查员可以共同花费所需数量的线索以推进场景。
acts.flavor: “这幢建筑年代久远，这里藏着各种秘密通道。”皮博迪先生解释说，“也许哪一条就通往你要找的这间图书馆。”
acts.advanceText:
调查员必须决定(选择一项)：
- 这可是重大发现！我们应该拿走它。(→结局1)
- 这只是个无聊的小配饰，而且我们也不应该偷历史协会的东西。把它留下。(→结局2)

agendas.name: 埋藏的真相
agendas.text:
跳过神话阶段的“在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记”步骤。(FAQ，v1.2)
强制 - 有1点或以上线索放置到场上的敌人后：将这些线索翻至其毁灭标记面。
agendas.flavor: 历史协会安置在一幢乔治王时代的宅邸里，你到达时惊讶地发现宅子的门半掩着。都这个点了，还会有什么人来这里吗？
agendas.advanceText: 将遭遇弃牌堆洗入遭遇牌库。

agendas.name: 洗劫宅邸
agendas.text:
跳过神话阶段的“在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记”步骤。(FAQ，v1.2)
强制 - 有1点或以上线索放置到场上的敌人后：将这些线索翻至其毁灭标记面。
agendas.flavor: 虽然低语声平息了，但翻箱倒柜的声音却决计错不了。不管那是谁，他们的搜查一定极为仔细……
agendas.advanceText:
将放在一边的附身宣誓者敌人生成在入口大厅。
检查剧本日志。如果“贵宾遇害”下没有塞巴斯蒂安·莫罗，查找收藏，找出塞巴斯蒂安·莫罗(歇斯底里的蛮子)并将其生成在入口大厅。

agendas.name: 不能揭开的秘密
agendas.text:
跳过神话阶段的“在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记”步骤。(FAQ，v1.2)
强制 - 有1点或以上线索放置到场上的敌人后：将这些线索翻至其毁灭标记面。
agendas.flavor: 不管这些人是谁，他们一定和《黄衣之王》背后的阴谋有关。你绝不能让他们找到他们要找的东西！

01169.name: 祭司
01169.text:
生成 - 任意无人地点。
强制 - 在祭司入场后：在祭司上放置1个毁灭标记。
01169.flavor: 这不过是微不足道的祭品。

01170.name: 密会巫师
01170.text:
生成 - 任意无人地点。
反击。
强制 - 当神话阶段结束时：在密会巫师上放置1个毁灭标记。

03098.name: 狂徒
03098.text:
生成 - 线索最多的已揭示地点。
强制 - 在狂徒入场后：将狂徒所在地点的1个线索移动到狂徒上。
强制 - 在你击败狂徒时：控制其所有线索。

03099.name: 王之特使
03099.text:
猎物 - 线索最多。
猎手。
强制 - 在王之特使攻击你后：将你的1个线索移动到王之特使上。
强制 - 在你击败王之特使时：控制其所有线索。

03140.name: 附身宣誓者
03140.text:
猎手。反击。
场景1和场景2期间不能受到伤害。
强制 - 当敌军阶段开始时：调查员必须重整附身宣誓者或在其上放置1个毁灭标记。
目标 - 如果附身宣誓者被击败：(→结局3)

03144.name: 卡尔克萨探求者
03144.text:
生成 - 任意无人历史协会地点。
冷漠。
强制 - 当神话阶段结束时：将卡尔克萨探求者所在地点的1个线索移动到卡尔克萨探求者上(如果你不能这么做，改为在卡尔克萨探求者上放置1个毁灭标记)。

03068b.name: 塞巴斯蒂安·莫罗
03068b.text:
猎手。反击。
塞巴斯蒂安·莫罗的攻击不能被取消。
03068b.flavor: “想不想参加我们下一场演出？”

01171.name: 神秘咏唱
01171.text: 显现 - 在最近的一个[[异教徒]]敌人上放置2个毁灭标记。如果场上没有[[异教徒]]敌人，查找遭遇牌库及弃牌堆，从中找出并抽取一个[[异教徒]]敌人(混洗遭遇牌库)。

01174.name: 上锁的门
01174.text:
显现 - 附属到线索最多且没有附属上锁的门的地点。
附属的地点不能被调查。
[action]：检定[combat](4)以破门而入或[agility](4)以撬开门锁。如果你检定成功，弃掉上锁的门。

03084a.name: 脑海中的低语
03084a.text:
险境。隐私。
显现 - 将脑海中的低语(沮丧)秘密加入你的手牌。
你不能在技能检定投入技能卡牌。
[action][action]：从你手牌中弃掉脑海中的低语(沮丧)。

03084b.name: 脑海中的低语
03084b.text:
险境。隐私。
显现 - 将脑海中的低语(惊惧)秘密加入你的手牌。
你每回合不能移动超过一次。
[action][action]：从你手牌中弃掉脑海中的低语(惊惧)。

03084c.name: 脑海中的低语
03084c.text:
险境。隐私。
显现 - 将脑海中的低语(焦虑)秘密加入你的手牌。
你不能触发[free]能力。
[action][action]：从你手牌中弃掉脑海中的低语(焦虑)。

03084d.name: 脑海中的低语
03084d.text:
险境。隐私。
显现 - 将脑海中的低语(疑惑)秘密加入你的手牌。
你不能打出事件。
[action][action]：从你手牌中弃掉脑海中的低语(疑惑)。

03085.name: 深陷疯狂
03085.text:
涌动。
显现 - 如果你身上有至少3点恐惧，失去1个行动。
03085.flavor:
她僵住了，如同骨鲠在喉。
她的眼睛开始落泪，世界在她眼中盘旋，
模糊，许久许久之后，她终于明白了。

03100.name: 王之法令
03100.text: 显现 - 场上每有1个[[异教徒]]敌人，就将该敌人所在地点的1个线索移动到该敌人上。直到一轮结束，对于场上每个[[异教徒]]敌人，该敌人上每有1个线索和/或毁灭标记，就使其得到+1攻击。如果没有因本效果移动的线索，王之法令获得涌动。

03145.name: 引入歧途
03145.text:
险境。
显现 - 你必须决定(选择一项)：
- 将你的1个线索放置到一个[[异教徒]]敌人上。
- 在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记(本效果可以导致当前密谋推进)。

03146.name: 邪教的搜查
03146.text: 显现 - 如果场上有带有毁灭标记的[[异教徒]]敌人，将每个[[异教徒]]敌人上的所有毁灭标记移动到当前密谋上(本效果可以导致当前密谋推进)。如果场上没有带有毁灭标记的[[异教徒]]敌人，查找遭遇牌库和遭遇弃牌堆，找出一个[[异教徒]]敌人并将其抽取(混洗遭遇牌库)。

01136.name: 错误指示
01136.text: 显现 - 如果你没有线索，错误指示获得涌动。如果你有至少1个线索，检定[intellect](4)。你检定失败且每低于难度1点，将你的1个线索放到你所在地点。

01135.name: 追猎鬼影
01135.text:
险境。
显现 - 你必须(选择以下一项)：花费1个线索或受到2点伤害。
01135.flavor: 一个鬼魅般的人影在雨中跟踪你。你回头注视它，却突然头痛欲裂，视线模糊。

03141.name: 皮博迪先生
03141.text: [action]横置皮博迪先生：选择一个地点。直到皮博迪先生重整，该地点隐藏值-1并获得[[通道]]特性。
03141.flavor: “这幢建筑有许多秘密。我可以带你看，但我也不是什么都知道……”

03142.name: 黑玛瑙扣环
03142.text: 黑玛瑙扣环在你手牌中时，你每张其他手牌的费用提升1点。
03142.flavor: 它既不是来自阿拉伯，也不是来自中国，之后我才发现，任何人类文稿都没有关于它的记载。罗伯特·W·钱伯斯，“黄色印记”，《黄衣之王》

03143.name: 褴褛披风
03143.text:
你得到-1神智值。
你的剩余神智值不多于3时，你得到+1[willpower]，+1[combat]，+1[agility]。

resolutions.r1: 拿走黑玛瑙扣环，记录 1 点确信，并将符号标记替换为 2 枚异教徒。
resolutions.r2: 将黑玛瑙扣环留在原处，记录 1 点疑惑，并将符号标记替换为 2 枚石板。
resolutions.r3: 摧毁附身宣誓者；可以将褴褛披风加入一位调查员的牌组，并将符号标记替换为 2 枚石板。
resolutions.r4: 印记的追随者获得进展；获得 1 点奖励经验，并将符号标记替换为 2 枚古神。

locations.name: 入口大厅
locations.text:
入口大厅与其他每个[[一楼]]地点连接。
[action]：撤退。你逃走了，把过去的谜团留给那些神秘的异教徒。

locations.name: 宁静的走廊
locations.text:
宁静的走廊与其他每个[[二楼]]地点连接。
[action]如果场上每个地点均已揭示，且场上所有地点上均没有线索：在宁静的走廊上放置1[per_investigator]个线索(从供应堆拿取)。

locations.name: 宁静的走廊
locations.text:
宁静的走廊与其他每个[[三楼]]地点连接。
[action]如果场上每个地点均已揭示，且场上所有地点上均没有线索：在宁静的走廊上放置1[per_investigator]个线索(从供应堆拿取)。

locations.name: 历史协会
locations.text: 位于本地点的每个敌人得到+1攻击与+1躲避。
locations.flavor: 这间狭小的房间里堆满了无数文件，本来这些能帮你进行有效调查，可惜文件柜抽屉里塞满了黏稠，恶臭的烂泥。

locations.name: 历史协会
locations.text: [action]横置一个[[盟友]]支援：发现本地点的1个线索。(每轮仅限一次。)
locations.flavor: 一把椅子打翻在地，天花板上破了一个窟窿。是谁搞的破坏？

sections.title: 你曾见过黄色印记吗？
paragraphs: “他提到了整个王朝是如何在卡尔克萨建立起来的，还有那些将哈斯塔、毕宿五和毕星团的秘密联系起来的湖泊。他还说起了卡西露达和卡米拉，还谈到了德姆赫和哈利湖那阴郁的深渊。”
——罗伯特·W·钱伯斯，“名誉修复师”

sections.title: 战役序章 · 序幕
paragraphs: 你翻开手中折起的节目单，再次阅读彷佛你已读过百遍的这张纸片。“米斯卡塔尼克剧院上演：《黄衣之王》，”纸上这么写着。“阿卡姆本地的沃德剧院将迎来这部戏剧的特别上演，为期一晚。这部令人无法抗拒的戏剧共有两幕。本作品由奈杰尔·英格兰姆负责筹划和管理。本剧演员均属于一个小型剧团，在演员名单最后还有个未署名的人物：“陌生人。”

这样一部万众期待的戏剧不远万里从巴黎来到阿卡姆，即便只上演一夜它也备受瞩目。在演出前的几个星期里，它一直是城中热话。虽然迹象不甚明显……然而，你有证据证明有某种邪恶势力正在行动。最初是剧院有个舞台工作人员失踪——一个才十七岁的男孩在一次彩排中缺席，之后就再也没人见过他。到距离演出已不到两个星期的时候，一位音乐家被发现死亡，并且尸体口中含着枪。或许最让人生畏的是警察从独立广场抓到的疯汉，他满口胡言乱语，说着“王已归来”之类的疯话。他被带到阿卡姆疯人院之后你惊讶地发现，产生这种妄想的并不止他一人。
你和你的同伴们经过深入调查之后，发现这些事件十分可疑。尽管无法证实这些事件之间有何关联，而这部即将上演的戏剧周围所发生的离奇事件远不止这些。一椿椿自杀事件和发疯事件接踵而来，你决心要找出背后的真相。

观众席的灯光暗了下来，聚光灯投下的灯光落在舞台上。眼前的情景与你的预期相去甚远。《黄衣之王》的第一幕缓慢而单调，使人感到无聊乏味。这部戏剧的背景和角色足够吸引，但曲折而怪诞的剧情却未能娱乐观众，也无法传达什么信息。你开始怀疑这些发生在《黄衣之王》周围的骇人事件之间是不是根本就没有联系。或许这不过是你的过度想像；这场平凡而不起眼的演出怎能引起这般混乱？令你吃惊的是第一幕没有任何高潮和转折就骤然结束了。幕间休息时灯光亮起，你忍住哈欠，想要提早离场。你正在踌躇之中，突然感觉自己困意越来越浓……最终昏睡了过去。

sections.title: 冒险 I: 谢幕
paragraphs: 你被一股看不见的力量摇醒了。你肯定是睡了很长一段时间，此时观众席上只剩下几个观众，舞台上也不见表演者的踪影。舞台的幕布破破烂烂，灯光昏暗，但你记不起来在第一幕的时候是否也是这幅景象。你等了好一会才确定这并非演出的一部分。就在你等待的时候，一股难以名状的恶臭在空气中弥漫。你到底睡了多久？你摆脱了困意，向坐在座位上的一个观众走去，问他现在是什么时候，但他没有回答你。此时你意识到你正在对一具尸体说话。
“他提到了整个王朝是如何在卡尔克萨建立起来的，还有那些将哈斯塔、毕宿五和毕星团的秘密联系起来的湖泊。他还说起了卡西露达和卡米拉，还谈到了德姆赫和哈利湖那阴郁的深渊。”
——罗伯特·W·钱伯斯，“名誉修复师”
你翻开手中折起的节目单，再次阅读彷佛你已读过百遍的这张纸片。“米斯卡塔尼克剧院上演：《黄衣之王》，”纸上这么写着。“阿卡姆本地的沃德剧院将迎来这部戏剧的特别上演，为期一晚。这部令人无法抗拒的戏剧共有两幕。本作品由奈杰尔·英格兰姆负责筹划和管理。本剧演员均属于一个小型剧团，在演员名单最后还有个未署名的人物：“陌生人。”

这样一部万众期待的戏剧不远万里从巴黎来到阿卡姆，即便只上演一夜它也备受瞩目。在演出前的几个星期里，它一直是城中热话。虽然迹象不甚明显……然而，你有证据证明有某种邪恶势力正在行动。最初是剧院有个舞台工作人员失踪——一个才十七岁的男孩在一次彩排中缺席，之后就再也没人见过他。到距离演出已不到两个星期的时候，一位音乐家被发现死亡，并且尸体口中含着枪。或许最让人生畏的是警察从独立广场抓到的疯汉，他满口胡言乱语，说着“王已归来”之类的疯话。他被带到阿卡姆疯人院之后你惊讶地发现，产生这种妄想的并不止他一人。
你和你的同伴们经过深入调查之后，发现这些事件十分可疑。尽管无法证实这些事件之间有何关联，而这部即将上演的戏剧周围所发生的离奇事件远不止这些。一椿椿自杀事件和发疯事件接踵而来，你决心要找出背后的真相。

观众席的灯光暗了下来，聚光灯投下的灯光落在舞台上。眼前的情景与你的预期相去甚远。《黄衣之王》的第一幕缓慢而单调，使人感到无聊乏味。这部戏剧的背景和角色足够吸引，但曲折而怪诞的剧情却未能娱乐观众，也无法传达什么信息。你开始怀疑这些发生在《黄衣之王》周围的骇人事件之间是不是根本就没有联系。或许这不过是你的过度想像；这场平凡而不起眼的演出怎能引起这般混乱？令你吃惊的是第一幕没有任何高潮和转折就骤然结束了。幕间休息时灯光亮起，你忍住哈欠，想要提早离场。你正在踌躇之中，突然感觉自己困意越来越浓……最终昏睡了过去。
你被一股看不见的力量摇醒了。你肯定是睡了很长一段时间，此时观众席上只剩下几个观众，舞台上也不见表演者的踪影。舞台的幕布破破烂烂，灯光昏暗，但你记不起来在第一幕的时候是否也是这幅景象。你等了好一会才确定这并非演出的一部分。就在你等待的时候，一股难以名状的恶臭在空气中弥漫。你到底睡了多久？你摆脱了困意，向坐在座位上的一个观众走去，问他现在是什么时候，但他没有回答你。此时你意识到你正在对一具尸体说话。

story.title: 未达成结局
paragraphs: 你再次从睡梦中惊醒，这次将你弄醒的是搭在你肩膀上的一只手，它的手指冰冷，又黏又湿。“你还好吗？”一位老人搀扶你起身，关切地问道。你脑海里的记忆十分凌乱。你只记得在最后，沃德剧院已经变成了一个噩梦，里面充斥着危险的狂热信徒和怪异而可怖的东西。你忧心仲仲地环顾周围，发现自己站在剧院外湿滑的路边。尽管早前发生过那些事件，这座城在你眼中并无异常——至少说，这对阿卡姆城来说挺正常的。车灯的强光刺入你的双眼，一辆车开了过来，将航脏的雨水溅到你身旁的人行道上。老人见你的眼中惊恐万分，表情对你十分关切。“你是遭贼了吗？那群惹是生非的坏小子真该死！”他大声骂道：“他们准是在今晚到剧院来为非作歹了！我跟你说，这儿到处都是他们的地盘。”
你站了起来，走到沃德剧院前门的窗户前，试着往里看看，但因为里面太黑，你什么都看不见。老人好奇地看了你一会，耸了耸肩然后走开了。“好吧，我得走了。我要是你的话我也会早些离开的，”他说完就拐过了街角。你快步跟上，想要提醒他远离剧院。但当你走过转角时，那位老人已经不见踪影，你只见陌生人戴着他那毫无特征的苍白面具，向你投来熟悉的视线。他定定地注视着你。
“你是谁？”你大声问道。陌生人没有回答，而是转身离去，消失在剧院后的小巷中。你紧追在后，期望从他口中得到答案，但当你到达小巷时，那里空空如也——除了在剧院员工入口旁边张贴的一张告示，“别扫兴了！ 快来参加《黄衣之王》的庆功派对吧。晚上八点在大西洋街1452号，康斯坦丝·杜梅因的住宅举行派对。请着正装到场。”你从墙上撕下这张告示并且收了起来，心中既沮丧又茫然。

sections.title: 冒险 II: 最后的王者
paragraphs: 若是有人能够解答使你抓心挠肝的那些问题，那准是《黄衣之王》的演职人员了。眼下没有其他的线索可以追寻，你穿上你最光鲜的衣装，前往大西洋街1452号，一位名叫康斯坦丝·杜梅因的女士将在那儿举办庆功宴会，庆祝这部戏剧在阿卡姆城成功上演。
若是有人能够解答使你抓心挠肝的那些问题，那准是《黄衣之王》的演职人员了。眼下没有其他的线索可以追寻，你穿上你最光鲜的衣装，前往大西洋街1452号，一位名叫康斯坦丝·杜梅因的女士将在那儿举办庆功宴会，庆祝这部戏剧在阿卡姆城成功上演。

story.title: 结局 1
paragraphs: 当你离开这个庄园时，凛冽的秋风向你袭来。你心中确信无疑，《黄衣之王》的演职人员都被疯狂所影响。或许这也将发生在你的身上。你感觉到一股黑暗逐渐渗入，陌生人的凝视仿佛渗入你的脑海中。惊惧之下，你逃出庄园之后首次细看前院。景象……不同了。与你第一次到来时不同，前窗并未破碎。你在门廊发现的血迹已被抹净，与你在进入这幢建筑时听到的令人不安的扭曲的音乐不同，此时从庭院传来的是轻柔而舒缓的爵士乐曲调。

01001.backFlavor: Roland had always taken comfort in procedure and rules. As an agent in the Bureau, he was relieved to have guidelines to follow in any given situation. But lately, his Federal Agent's Handbook had been entirely unhelpful given the cases he'd been assigned. Try as he might, Roland could find no mention of what to do when confronted with strange creatures, gates through time and space, or magic spells. If he hadn't seen it with his own eyes, he would never have believed it... and there's no way his superiors would understand. Roland knew he would have to handle this one himself.
01001.backFlavorZh: 遵照流程和规则往往让罗兰感到放心。身为联邦探员，罗兰的手册在任何情况下都能派上用场，这真是令他宽慰。但最近，他的联邦探员手册在任务里完全派不上用场。无论多么努力，罗兰也找不到哪里提及了遭遇奇怪生物、时空之门，和魔法咒文的对策。要不是亲眼所见，他自己也绝不会相信……他的上峰也是绝不会明白的。罗兰知道，这次他可得靠自己了。

01001.flavor: Everything by the book: every "i" dotted, every "t" crossed. It had worked, until now.
01001.flavorZh:
事无巨细的办案准则过去有用，
但现在照本宣科可行不通了。
01001.name: 罗兰·班克斯
01001.text:
[reaction] After you defeat an enemy: Discover 1 clue at your location. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1 for each clue on your location.
01001.textZh:
[reaction]你击败一个敌人后：发现你所在地点的1个线索。(每轮仅限一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：你所在地点每有一个线索，+1。

01002.backFlavor: As a respected librarian at Miskatonic University, Daisy had always felt that books were the most important thing in her life. She explored in fiction what she abhorred in life: horror, violence, fear. Then, she stumbled across the John Dee translation of the Necronomicon. It was blasphemous, unholy, and too awful to be read. But given her studies in obscure and occult subjects, Daisy knew there was more truth than fiction within the book's pages. She began to wonder what other secrets the restricted collection of the Orne Library held...
01002.backFlavorZh: 黛西是米斯卡塔尼克大学里受人尊敬的图书馆员，她一直都觉得自己生命里最重要的就是书。恐怖、暴力、惊惧，这些日常生活中嫌恶的东西，她在书里倒是看得津津有味。她随即一头陷进了约翰·迪伊翻译的《死灵之书》。这是亵渎、污秽，毛骨悚然、难以置信。但根据自己对神秘事物和密教主题的研究，黛西知道，这本书里事实大于虚构。她开始好奇，在奥恩图书馆的限制区里，还藏着什么其他秘密……

01002.flavor: "I know of books so powerful, they can rewrite reality."
01002.flavorZh: “我知道有些书强大无比，甚至能改写现实。”
01002.name: 黛西·沃克

你可以在自己回合期间执行额外一个行动，该行动只能用于[[书籍]]的[action]能力。

01003.backFlavor: Skids hadn't planned on a life of crime. But sometimes doing the right thing means getting your hands dirty. The cops didn't care that Skids needed the money for his mother's operation. His mother died of her illness during the second year of his sentence. His cellmate, Brad Hollins, told him there were worse fates than death. He ranted and raved in a quiet voice every evening about the "Old Ones" and told Skids about bizarre adventures he'd had while dreaming. Skids didn't give it much thought until the night he woke to the sight of his cellmate bursting into flames. When Skids was finally released, he returned to Arkham, looking for answers.
01003.backFlavorZh: “倒霉蛋”本来想做个好人。但有的时候，要对得起自已的良心，就得不干不净。尽管他要钱是为了妈妈的手术，但这些条子可不会管。就在他服刑的第二年，妈妈因病去世。但狱友布拉德·霍林告诉他，还有比死亡更糟糕的事。他每晚都无声地嘶喊“古神”之事，把自己梦到的奇异旅程都告诉“倒莓蛋”。“倒霉蛋”本来没当回事，直到有一晚，他起夜看到了狱友烧成了灰。等到终于出狱的时候，“倒霉蛋”回到了阿卡姆寻求答案。
01003.backText:

01003.flavor: "I didn't get out of the joint just to watch the world end."
01003.flavorZh: “我从狱中出来，可不是为了看世界末日的。”
01003.name: “倒霉蛋”奥图尔

[elder_sign] effect: +2. If you succeed, gain 2 resources.

[free]在你回合期间，花费2资源：你本回合可以进行额外1次行动。(每回合仅限一次)
[elder_sign]效果：+2。如果你成功，获得2资源。

01004.backFlavor: Agnes Baker may be just an unassuming waitress in this life, but in a previous life, in a time and age undreamed of in the modern world, she had been a powerful witch. It began when she found a strange artifact - a key of some kind - in a dusty collection of family belongings in her attic. When she touched it, the memories came flooding back, along with one word: "Hyperborea." The more she delved into the visions and memories of her former life, the stronger her powers grew... and the more frightened she became.
01004.backFlavorZh: 艾格尼丝·贝克今生可能只是个毕恭毕敬的侍应，但在超越现代世界想象的前生，她可是个强大的女巫。一切都源自她在自家阁楼那堆落满灰的传家宝里发现的奇怪神器一一大概是某种钥匙。她触碰的时候，记忆如潮水般涌来，一同奔流的还有另一个词：“希波利尔”。越是深入幻景和前世的记忆，她的力量也就越强大……但她也就更加害怕。

01004.flavor: "I remember another life, one of sorcery and conquest."
01004.flavorZh: “我记得另一段人生，满是巫术和征服。”
01004.name: 艾格尼丝·贝克

[reaction] After 1 or more horror is placed on Agnes Baker: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location. (Limit once per phase.)

[elder_sign]效果：艾格尼丝·贝克每有1点恐惧，+1。

01005.backFlavor: Mama used to let Wendy play with her necklace when she was small. Mama would tell her stories, and Wendy would spin the necklace and watch as it glittered. Then, word came that her father had been lost at sea, and Mama started acting strange, drawing unusual symbols in chalk all over the house. They took Mama to the asylum, and Wendy went to the orphanage. Before they took her away, Mama gave her the necklace, to "protect her." Wendy stayed in the orphanage for several years before running away, deciding that she could take better care of herself on her own.
01005.backFlavorZh: 温蒂还小的时候，妈妈常让她玩自己的项链。妈妈会讲她的故事，温蒂则转着项链，看它闪闪发光。然后，话就说到爸爸在海上失踪，妈妈也开始行为古怪，在房子里用粉笔画满了反常的符号。妈妈被带到了疯人院，温蒂则去了孤儿院。但妈妈在被带走前，把项链留给了温蒂，说是能“保护她”。温蒂在孤儿院里待了几年，然后溜了出来，她决定能靠自己活得更好。
01005.backText:
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0-5, Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0-2, Neutral cards level 0-5.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Wendy's Amulet, Abandoned and Alone, 1 random basic weakness.
01005.backTextZh:
牌库卡牌张数：30。
牌库构建选项：求生者卡牌([survivor])等级0-5，流浪者卡牌([rogue])等级0-2，中立卡牌等级0-5。
牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：温蒂的护身符、被抛弃的孤单、1张随机基础弱点。
01005.name: 温蒂·亚当斯
01005.text:
[reaction] When you reveal a chaos token, choose and discard 1 card from your hand: Cancel that chaos token and return it to the bag. Reveal a new chaos token. (Limit once per test/ability.)
[elder_sign] effect: +0. If Wendy's Amulet is in play, you automatically succeed instead.
01005.textZh:
[reaction]在你揭示一个混乱标记时，选择并弃掉你1张手牌：取消该混乱标记并将其放回混乱袋。揭示一个新的混乱标记。(每次检定/能力仅限一次)
[elder_sign]效果：+0。如果温蒂的护身符在场，改为你自动成功。

01006.name: 罗兰 的.38特制手枪
01006.text:
Roland Banks deck only.
Uses (4 ammo).
[action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack (if there are 1 or more clues on your location, you get +3 [combat], instead). This attack deals +1 damage.
01006.textZh:
罗兰·班克斯牌库专用。
使用(4子弹)。
[action]花费1子弹：攻击。你本次攻击得到+1[combat](如果你所在地点至少有1个线索，改为你得到+3[combat])。本次攻击造成+1伤害。

01007.name: 掩盖罪证
01007.text:
Revelation - Put Cover Up into play in your threat area, with 3 clues on it.
[reaction] When you would discover 1 or more clues at your location: Discard that many clues from Cover Up instead.
Forced - When the game ends, if there are any clues on Cover Up: You suffer 1 mental trauma.
01007.textZh:
显现 - 将掩盖罪证放置入场，放到你的威胁区域，并在上面放置3个线索。
[reaction]在你将要发现你所在地点的至少1个线索时：改为弃掉掩盖罪证上同等数量的线索。
强制 - 在游戏结束时，如果掩盖罪证上有线索：你承受1点精神创伤。

01008.name: 黛西的手提包
01008.text:
Daisy Walker deck only.
You have 2 additional hand slots, which can only be used to hold [[Tome]] assets.
01008.textZh:
黛西·沃克牌库专用。
你拥有额外2个手部槽位，只可以用来携带[[书籍]]支援。

01009.name: 死灵之书
01009.text:
Revelation - Put The Necronomicon into play in your threat area, with 3 horror on it. It cannot leave play while it has 1 or more horror on it.
Treat each [elder_sign] you reveal on a chaos token as a [auto_fail].
[action]: Move 1 horror from The Necronomicon to Daisy Walker. Then, if The Necronomicon has no horror on it, discard it.
01009.textZh:
显现 - 将死灵之书放置入场，放到你的威胁区域，带有3点恐惧。死灵之书上有恐惧时不能离场。
将你揭示的每个混乱标记上的[elder_sign]视为[auto_fail]。
[action]：将死灵之书的1点恐惧移动到黛西·沃克上。然后，如果死灵之书没有恐惧，将其弃掉。

01010.flavor: I ain't going to the pen a second time.
01010.name: 在逃中
01010.text:
"Skids" O'Toole deck only.
Fast. Play after your turn begins.
Until the end of the round, non-[[Elite]] enemies cannot attack you.
01010.textZh:
“倒霉蛋”奥图尔牌库专用。
快速。在你回合开始后打出。
直到本轮结束，非[[精英]]敌人不能攻击你。

01011.name: 医院债务
01011.text:
Revelation - Put Hospital Debts into play in your threat area.
[fast]: Move 1 resource from your resource pool to Hospital Debts. (Limit twice per round.)
Forced - When the game ends, if Hospital Debts has fewer than 6 resources on it: You earn 2 fewer experience for this scenario.
01011.textZh:
显现 - 将医院债务放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。
[free]：将你资源池的1资源移动到医院债务。(每轮限制两次。)
强制 - 在游戏结束时，如果医院债务的资源少于6：你本场冒险少取得2点经验值。

01012.flavor: The etchings on its surface change from day to day, shifting and moving whenever I'm not looking.
01012.flavorZh: 这表面的刻痕日日生变，甚至我不经意间的时时刻刻都在变。
01012.name: 希波利尔传家宝
01012.text:
Agnes Baker deck only.
[reaction] After you play a [[Spell]] card: Draw 1 card.
01012.textZh:
艾格尼丝·贝克牌库专用。
[reaction]你打出一张[[法术]]卡后：抽取1张卡牌。

01013.name: 黑暗回忆
01013.text:
Place 1 doom on the current agenda. This effect can cause the current agenda to advance.
Forced - If Dark Memory is in your hand at the end of your turn, reveal it and take 2 horror.
01013.textZh:
在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。本效果能导致当前密谋推进。
强制 - 如果当你回合结束时，黑暗回忆在你手中：将其揭示并受到2点恐惧。

01014.name: 温蒂的护身符
01014.text:
Wendy Adams deck only.
You may play the topmost event in your discard pile as if it were in your hand.
Forced - After you play an event or discard an event from play: Place it on the bottom of your deck instead of in your discard pile.
01014.textZh:
温蒂·亚当斯牌库专用。
你可以打出你弃牌堆最顶部的事件，如同其是你的手牌。
强制 - 你打出一张事件后：不将其放入你的弃牌堆，改为将其放到你的牌库底。

01015.flavor: I don't need them. I don't need anyone.
01015.flavorZh: 我不需要他们。我不需要任何人。
01015.name: 被抛弃的孤单
01015.text: Revelation - Take 2 direct horror and remove all cards in your discard pile from the game.
01015.textZh: 显现 - 受到2点直接恐惧并将你弃牌堆的所有卡牌从游戏中移除。

01016.name: .45自动手枪
01016.text:
Uses (4 ammo).
[action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage.
01016.textZh:
使用(4子弹)。
[action]花费1子弹：攻击。你本次攻击得到+1[combat]。本次攻击造成+1伤害。

01017.name: 体能训练
01017.text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [willpower] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [combat] for this skill test.
01017.textZh:
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[willpower]。
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[combat]。

01018.name: 巡警
01018.text:
You get +1 [combat].
[fast] Discard Beat Cop: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location.
01018.textZh:
你得到+1[combat]。
[free]弃掉巡警：对你所在地点的1个敌人造成1点伤害。

01019.name: 急救
01019.text:
Uses (3 supplies). If First Aid has no supplies, discard it.
[action] Spend 1 supply: Heal 1 damage or horror from an investigator at your location.
01019.textZh:
使用(3补给)。如果急救没有补给，将其弃掉。
[action]花费1补给：治愈你所在地点的一位调查员1点伤害或1点恐惧。

01020.flavor: Cuts through vines, underbrush, and tentacles equally well.
01020.flavorZh: 无论是藤蔓、灌木，还是触手，切起来都是一样快。
01020.name: 大砍刀
01020.text: [action]: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack. If the attacked enemy is the only enemy engaged with you, this attack deals +1 damage.
01020.textZh: [action]：攻击。你本次攻击得到+1[combat]。如果被攻击的敌人是唯一与你交战的敌人，本次攻击造成+1伤害。

01021.flavor: Fiercely loyal, these trained canines make for perfect companions.
01021.flavorZh: 这些训练有素的犬只绝对忠诚，是冒险的好伙伴。
01021.name: 看门狗
01021.text: [reaction] When an enemy attack deals damage to Guard Dog: Deal 1 damage to the attacking enemy.
01021.textZh: [reaction]在敌人的攻击对看门狗造成伤害时：对攻击敌人造成1点伤害。

01022.name: 证据！
01022.text:
Fast. Play after you defeat an enemy.
Discover 1 clue at your location.
01022.textZh:
快速。在你击败一个敌人后打出。
发现你所在地点的1个线索。

01023.name: 闪躲
01023.text:
Fast. Play when an enemy attacks an investigator at your location.
Cancel that attack.
01023.textZh:
快速。在一个敌人攻击你所在地点的一位调查员时打出。
取消该次攻击。

01024.name: 炸药爆破
01024.text: Choose either your location or a connecting location. Deal 3 damage to each enemy and to each investigator at the chosen location.
01024.textZh: 选择你所在地点或一个连接地点。对所选地点的每个敌人和每位调查员各造成3点伤害。

01025.flavor: With a sickening smack, he struck the abomination over and over... until at last, it stopped moving.
01025.flavorZh: 随着一阵阵令人作呕的响声，他不停打击那个怪物直到它再也无法动弹。
01025.name: 致命打击
01025.text: If this skill test is successful during an attack, that attack deals +1 damage.
01025.textZh: 如果攻击期间本次技能检定成功，则本次攻击造成+1伤害。

01026.flavor: I've never met a beast that could outsmart a bullet.
01026.flavorZh: 我可没见过野兽能胜过子弹。
01026.name: 多余的弹药
01026.text: Place 3 ammo tokens on a [[Firearm]] asset controlled by an investigator at your location.
01026.textZh: 在你所在地点一位调查员控制的1个[[枪械]]支援上放置3个子弹标记。

01027.name: 警徽
01027.text:
You get +1 [willpower].
[fast] While an investigator at your location is taking his or her turn, discard Police Badge: That investigator may take 2 additional actions this turn.
01027.textZh:
你得到+1[willpower]。
[free]你所在地点的调查员在进行自己回合时，弃掉警徽：该调查员本回合可以进行额外2次行动。

01028.name: 巡警
01028.text:
You get +1 [combat].
[fast] Exhaust Beat Cop and deal 1 damage to it: Deal 1 damage to an enemy at your location.
01028.textZh:
你得到+1[combat]。
[free]横置巡警并对其造成1点伤害：对你所在地点的一个敌人造成1点伤害。

01029.name: 霰弹枪
01029.text:
Uses (2 ammo).
[action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +3 [combat] for this attack. Instead of its standard damage, this attack deals 1 damage for each point you succeed by (to a minimum of 1, to a maximum of 5). If you fail and would damage another investigator, this attack deals 1 damage for each point you fail by (to a minimum of 1, to a maximum of 5).
01029.textZh:
使用(2子弹)。
[action]花费1子弹：攻击。你本次攻击得到+3[combat]。本次攻击不造成标准伤害，改为你检定成功且每超过难度1点，造成1点伤害(最小为1，最大为5)。如果你检定失败并将要对另一位调查员造成伤害，每低于难度1点，造成1点伤害(最小为1，最大为5)。

01030.flavor: A lens into a world unseen can reveal things you wish it hadn't.
01030.flavorZh: 透镜映照出平时看不见的世界，揭示的一切你却并不想看见。
01030.name: 放大镜
01030.textZh:
快速。
你调查时得到+1[intellect]。

01031.name: 智慧古书
01031.text: [action] Exhaust Old Book of Lore: Choose an investigator at your location. That investigator searches the top 3 cards of his or her deck for a card, draws it, and shuffles the remaining cards into his or her deck.
01031.textZh: [action]横置智慧古书：选择你所在地点的一位调查员。该调查员查找其牌库顶3张卡牌，找出一张将其抽取，并将剩余卡牌混洗入自己牌库。

01032.flavor: "There have been problems at the Orne Library, as we both know, given poor Armitage's condition, and the other, unrelated... incident of a few years ago..."
01032.flavorZh: “奥恩图书馆肯定有问题——我们都知道可怜的阿米蒂奇是什么情况，还有另一件，不相干的……几年前的事故……”
01032.name: 研究馆员
01032.text: [reaction] After Research Librarian enters play: Search your deck for a [[Tome]] asset and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
01032.textZh: [reaction]研究馆员入场后：查找你的牌库，找出一张[[书籍]]支援，并将其加入你的手牌。混洗你的牌库。

01033.flavor: "While I truly believe that this nightmare is just a singular abomination, I must admit that I am exhilarated by the possibility that this is but one specimen of a new genus!"
01033.flavorZh: “我确实祈祷这噩梦不过是偶然一例的畸变！但我也得承认，我实在是太高兴了！因为这可能是一种全新的生物！”
01033.name: 米兰·克里斯托弗博士
01033.text:
You get +1 [intellect].
[reaction] After you successfully investigate: Gain 1 resource.
01033.textZh:
你得到+1[intellect]。
[reaction]在你成功调查后：获得1资源。

01034.name: 超感知
01034.text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [intellect] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [agility] for this skill test.
01034.textZh:
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[intellect]。
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[agility]。

01035.name: 医学教科书
01035.text: [action] Choose an investigator at your location and test [intellect] (2). If you succeed, heal 1 damage from that investigator. If you fail, deal 1 damage to that investigator.
01035.textZh: [action]：选择你所在地点的一位调查员并检定[intellect](2)。如果你检定成功，治愈该调查员1点伤害。如果你检定失败，对该调查员造成1点伤害。

01036.name: 心胜于物
01036.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Until the end of the round, you may use your [intellect] in place of your [combat] and [agility].
01036.textZh:
快速。只能在你回合期间打出。
直到本轮结束，你可以用你的[intellect]代替你的[combat]和[agility]。

01037.name: 专业的直觉
01037.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Discover 1 clue at your location.
01037.textZh:
快速。只能在你回合期间打出。
发现你所在地点的1个线索。

01038.name: 屏障
01038.text:
Attach to your location.
Non-[[Elite]] enemies cannot move into attached location.
Forced - When an investigator leaves attached location: Discard Barricade.
01038.textZh:
附属到你所在地点。
非[[精英]]敌人不能移动进入附属的地点。
强制 - 在一位调查员离开附属地点时：弃掉屏障。

01039.flavor: I knew I had seen this symbol before. I must warn the others before it is too late!
01039.flavorZh: 我知道我看过这个符号。我必须赶在一切太迟之前警告其他人！
01039.name: 推理
01039.text: If this skill test is successful while investigating a location, discover 1 additional clue at that location.
01039.textZh: 如果调查一个地点时本技能检定成功，额外发现该地点的1个线索。

01040.flavor: A lens into a world unseen can reveal things you wish it hadn't.
01040.flavorZh: 透镜映照出平时看不见的世界，揭示的一切你却并不想看见。
01040.name: 放大镜
01040.text:
Fast.
You get +1 [intellect] while investigating.
[fast] If there are no clues on your location: Return Magnifying Glass to your hand.
01040.textZh:
快速。
你在调查时得到+1[intellect]。
[free]如果你所在地点没有线索：将放大镜返回你的手牌。

01041.flavor: Do they fear it because of what it will do to them? Or, do they fear it because of what it will do to you?
01041.flavorZh: 他们是害怕护身符对他们的效果？还是说，他们是害怕护身符对你的效果？
01041.name: 伊察姆纳圆盘
01041.text: [reaction] When a non-[[Elite]] enemy spawns at your location, discard Disc of Itzamna: Discard that enemy.
01041.textZh: [reaction]在非[[精英]]敌人生成在你所在地点时，弃掉伊察姆纳圆盘：弃掉该敌人。

01042.flavor: It's supposed to be comprehensive, but the more I search through its pages, the more I realize we know nothing about the real truths of the cosmos.
01042.flavorZh: 这本该包罗万象，但我越在书页中寻找，就越是发现我们其实对字宙一无所知。
01042.name: 百科全书
01042.text: [action] Exhaust Encyclopedia: Choose an investigator at your location. That investigator gets +2 to a skill of your choice until the end of the phase.
01042.textZh: [action]横置百科全书：选择你所在地点的一位调查员。直到本阶段结束，该调查员得到一项技能值(由你选择)+2。

01043.name: 隐秘的研究
01043.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Choose an investigator at your location. That investigator draws 3 cards.
01043.textZh:
快速。只能在你回合期间打出。
选择你所在地点的一位调查员。该调查员抽取3张卡牌。

01044.name: 弹簧刀
01044.text:
Fast.
[action]: Fight. If you succeed by 2 or more, this attack deals +1 damage.
01044.textZh:
快速。
[action]：攻击。如果你检定成功且超过难度至少2点，本次攻击造成+1伤害。

01045.name: 夜盗
01045.text: [action] Exhaust Burglary: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, gain 3 resources.
01045.textZh: [action]横置夜盗：调查。如果你检定成功，不发现线索，改为获得3资源。

01046.name: 扒窃
01046.text: [reaction] After you evade an enemy, exhaust Pickpocketing: Draw 1 card.
01046.textZh: [reaction]在你躲避1个敌人后，横置扒窃：抽取1张卡牌。

01047.name: .41短口手枪
01047.text:
Uses (3 ammo).
[action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. If you succeed by 2 or more, this attack deals +1 damage.
01047.textZh:
使用(3子弹)。
[action]花费1子弹：攻击。你本次攻击得到+2[combat]。如果你检定成功且超过难度至少2点，本次攻击造成+1伤害。

01048.flavor: "I was born in Mississippi. Louisiana just sounded better."
01048.flavorZh: “其实我出生在密西西比。路易斯安那只是更好听。”
01048.name: 里奥·德·卢卡
01048.text: You may take an additional action during your turn.
01048.textZh: 在你回合期间，你可以进行额外一次行动。

01049.name: 沉重打击
01049.text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [combat] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [agility] for this skill test.
01049.textZh:
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[combat]。
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[agility]。

01050.name: 逃避隐藏
01050.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Disengage from each enemy engaged with you and move to a revealed location with no enemies.
01050.textZh:
快速。只能在你回合期间打出。
和每个与你交战的敌人解除交战，并移动到一个没有敌人的已揭示地点。

01051.name: 背刺
01051.text: Fight. This attack uses [agility] instead of [combat]. This attack deals +2 damage.
01051.textZh: 攻击。本次攻击不使用[combat]，改为使用[agility]。本次攻击造成+2伤害。

01052.name: 偷袭
01052.text: Deal 2 damage to an exhausted enemy at your location.
01052.textZh: 对你所在地点的一名横置敌人造成2点伤害。

01053.name: 机会主义者
01053.text:
Commit only to a skill test you are performing.
If you succeed by 3 or more, return Opportunist to your hand after this test instead of discarding it.
01053.textZh:
只能投入你正在执行的技能检定。
如果你检定成功且超过难度至少3点，在本次检定后不将机会主义者弃掉，改为将其返回你的手牌。

01054.flavor: "I was born in Mississippi. Louisiana just sounded better."
01054.flavorZh: “其实我出生在密西西比。路易斯安那只是更好听。”
01054.name: 里奥·德·卢卡
01054.text: You may take an additional action during your turn.
01054.textZh: 在你回合期间，你可以进行额外一次行动。

01055.name: 飞贼
01055.text:
You get +1 [agility].
[action] Exhaust Cat Burglar: Disengage from each enemy engaged with you and move to a connecting location. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
01055.textZh:
你得到+1[agility]。
[action]横置飞贼：和每个与你交战的敌人解除交战，并移动到一个连接地点。本行动不会触发趁乱攻击。

01056.name: 老千手法
01056.text:
Fast. Play after you reveal a chaos token with a negative modifier.
Switch that token's "-" to a "+".
01056.textZh:
快速。在你揭示一个带有负值修正的混乱标记后打出。
将该标记的“-”变为“+”

01057.flavor: "I win again! Sorry sugar, it's just not your night."
01057.flavorZh: “我又赢咯！抱歉，甜心，你只是今晚运气有点差。”
01057.name: 百战百胜

01058.name: 禁忌知识
01058.text:
Uses (4 secrets). If Forbidden Knowledge has no secrets, discard it.
[fast] Exhaust Forbidden Knowledge and take 1 horror: Move 1 secret from Forbidden Knowledge to your resource pool, as a resource.
01058.textZh:
使用(4秘密)。如果禁忌知识没有秘密，将其弃掉。
[free]横置禁忌知识并受到1点恐惧：将禁忌知识上的1秘密移动到你的资源池，作为资源。

01059.flavor: Whether focused through a mundane trinket or a mystical artifact, there is real power in faith all the same.
01059.flavorZh: 无论是平常小物还是玄奥神器，蕴含在信仰之中的真正力量都是一样
01059.name: 圣玫瑰珠

01060.name: 皱缩术
01060.text:
Uses (4 charges).
[action] Spend 1 charge: Fight. This attack uses [willpower] instead of [combat] and deals +1 damage. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this attack, take 1 horror.
01060.textZh:
使用(4充能)。
[action]花费1充能：攻击。本次攻击不使用[combat]，改为使用[willpower]，并造成+1伤害。如果本次攻击期间揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，受到1点恐惧。

01061.name: 探知术
01061.text:
Uses (3 charges).
[action] Exhaust Scrying and spend 1 charge: Look at the top 3 cards of any investigator's deck or the encounter deck. Return them to the top of that deck in any order.
01061.textZh:
使用(3充能)。
[action]横置探知术并花费1充能：查看任意一位调查员的牌库顶或遭遇牌库顶3张卡牌。将其以任意顺序放回该牌库顶。

01062.name: 神秘研究
01062.text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [willpower] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [intellect] for this skill test.
01062.textZh:
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[willpower]。
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[intellect]。

01063.name: 新晋术士
01063.text:
Forced - After Arcane Initiate enters play: Place 1 doom on it.
[fast] Exhaust Arcane Initiate: Search the top 3 cards of your deck for a [[Spell]] card and draw it. Shuffle your deck.
01063.textZh:
强制 - 在新晋术士入场后：在该卡上放置1个毁灭标记。
[free] 横置新晋术士：查找你牌库顶的3张卡牌，找出一张[[法术]]卡牌并将其抽取。混洗你的牌库。

01064.flavor: "We live on a placid island of ignorance in the midst of black seas of infinity, and it was not meant that we should voyage far." <cite>H. P. Lovecraft, "The Call of Cthulhu"</cite>
01064.flavorZh: “我们生活在无限的黑海上，重重迷雾中一个名为无知的孤岛。但这并不意味着我们就该远航。”H. P. 洛夫克拉夫特，《克苏鲁的呼唤》
01064.name: 飞蛾扑火
01064.text: Draw the top card of the encounter deck. Then, discover 2 clues at your location.
01064.textZh: 抽取遭遇牌库顶的卡牌。然后，发现你所在地点的2个线索。

01065.name: 守护结界
01065.text:
Fast. Play when you draw a non-weakness treachery card.
Cancel that card's revelation effect. Then, take 1 horror.
01065.textZh:
快速。在你抽取一张非弱点的诡计卡牌时打出。
取消该卡牌的显现效果。然后，受到1点恐惧。

01066.name: 眩光一闪
01066.text: Evade. This evasion attempt uses [willpower] instead of [agility]. If you succeed, deal 1 damage to the enemy just evaded. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this evasion attempt, lose 1 action this turn.
01066.textZh: 躲避。这次躲避尝试不使用[agility]，改为使用[willpower]。如果检定成功，对刚躲避的敌人造成1点伤害。如果本次躲避尝试期间揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，本回合失去1个行动。

01067.flavor: Only by standing firm against the darkness can we live to see the light of another day.
01067.flavorZh: 只有在黑暗面前站稳脚步，才能活着看到明天的太阳。
01067.name: 无所畏惧
01067.text: If this skill test is successful, heal 1 horror.
01067.textZh: 如果本次技能检定成功，治愈1点恐惧。

01068.name: 记忆抹消
01068.text:
Fast. Play after a phase begins.
Choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location. Treat the chosen enemy's printed text box as if it were blank (except for [[Traits]]) until the end of the phase.
01068.textZh:
快速。在一个阶段开始后打出。
选择你所在地点的一个非[[精英]]敌人。将所选敌人的印刷文本框视为如同空白(除[[特性]]外)，直到本阶段结束。

01069.name: 眩光一闪
01069.text: Evade. This evasion attempt uses [willpower] instead of [agility]. If you succeed, deal 2 damage to the enemy just evaded. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this evasion attempt, lose 1 action this turn and take 1 horror.
01069.textZh: 躲避。这次躲避尝试不使用[agility]，改为使用[willpower]。如果检定成功，对刚躲避的敌人造成2点伤害。如果躲避尝试期间揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，本回合失去1个行动并受到1点恐惧。

01070.name: 影之书
01070.text:
You have 1 additional arcane slot.
[action] Exhaust Book of Shadows: Add 1 charge to a [[Spell]] asset you control.
01070.textZh:
你拥有额外1个法术槽位。
[action]横置影之书：为你控制的一个[[法术]]支援增加1充能。

01071.name: 诡秘石像
01071.text:
Uses (4 charges). If Grotesque Statue has no charges, discard it.
[reaction] When you would reveal a chaos token, spend 1 charge: Reveal 2 chaos tokens instead of 1. Choose 1 of those tokens to resolve, and ignore the other.
01071.textZh:
使用(4充能)。如果诡秘石像没有充能，将其弃掉。
[reaction]在你将要揭示一个混乱标记时，花费1充能：改为揭示2个混乱标记，而非1个。选择其中1个标记结算，并忽略另一个。

01072.flavor: The coat was not the most fashionable choice, but it did feel warm and reassuring in its bulk.
01072.flavorZh: 皮大衣可能不是最时尚的选择，但又厚又大，非常抗寒、可靠。
01072.name: 皮大衣

01073.name: 拾荒
01073.text: [reaction] After you successfully investigate by 2 or more, exhaust Scavenging: Choose an [[Item]] card in your discard pile and add it to your hand.
01073.textZh: [reaction]在你成功调查，且超过难度至少2点后，横置拾荒：在你的弃牌堆中选择一张[[道具]]卡牌，将其加入你的手中。

01074.name: 球棒
01074.text: [action]: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage. If a [skull] or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this attack, discard Baseball Bat after the attack resolves.
01074.textZh: [action]：攻击。你本次攻击得到+2[combat]。本次攻击造成+1伤害。如果攻击期间抽出[skull]或[auto_fail]符号，在攻击结算后弃掉球棒。

01075.flavor: They claimed it would bring me good luck. I wouldn't say that's true. But now I feel like it would be even worse luck to get rid of it.
01075.flavorZh: 他们说这能给我带来好运。我本来不信。但现在我觉得，要是丢了它，我可真要倒霉了。
01075.name: 幸运兔脚
01075.text: [reaction] After you fail a skill test, exhaust Rabbit's Foot: Draw 1 card.
01075.textZh: [reaction]在你技能检定失败后，横置幸运兔脚：抽取1张卡牌。

01076.flavor: He never came if you called for him. It always seemed like he had his own agenda.
01076.flavorZh: 他向来无视你的呼唤。看来他总是有自己的密谋。
01076.name: 野猫
01076.text: [fast] Discard Stray Cat: Automatically evade a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location.
01076.textZh: [free]弃掉野猫：自动躲避你所在地点的一个非[[精英]]敌人。

01077.name: 深挖
01077.text:
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [willpower] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [agility] for this skill test.
01077.textZh:
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[willpower]。
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[agility]。

01078.flavor: That should buy us some time.
01078.flavorZh: 这应该能为我们争取点时间。
01078.name: 调虎离山
01078.text: Evade. Automatically evade all enemies at your location.
01078.textZh: 躲避。自动躲避你所在地点的所有敌人。

01079.name: “看看我发现了什么！”
01079.text:
Fast. Play after you fail a skill test by 2 or less while investigating.
Discover 2 clues in your location.
01079.textZh:
快速。你调查时，技能检定失败且低于难度2点及以内后打出。
发现你所在地点的2个线索。

01080.name: 运气好！
01080.text:
Fast. Play when you would fail a skill test.
Get +2 to your skill value for that test.
01080.textZh:
快速。在你技能检定将要失败时打出。
该次检定你得到技能值+2。

01081.name: 求生本能
01081.text: If this skill test is successful during an evasion attempt, the evading investigator may immediately disengage from each other enemy engaged with him or her, and may move to a connecting location.
01081.textZh: 如果尝试躲避期间本次技能检定成功，躲避的调查员可以立即和每个与其交战的其他敌人解除交战，并可以移动到一个连接地点。

01082.flavor: "Do not be frightened by what you see. Be frightened by what you cannot see."
01082.flavorZh: “不要害怕你所看到的。害怕你看不到的。”
01082.name: 安奎娜
01082.text: [reaction] When an enemy attacks you, exhaust Aquinnah and deal 1 horror to her: Deal that enemy's damage to another enemy at your location, instead. (You still take horror dealt by the attack.)
01082.textZh: [reaction]在敌人攻击你时，横置安奎娜并对她造成1点恐惧：改为对你所在地点的另一个敌人造成该敌人的伤害。(你依然受到此次攻击的恐惧。)

01083.name: 千钧一发
01083.text:
Fast. Play after a non-weakness, non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location is evaded.
Shuffle that enemy into the encounter deck.
01083.textZh:
快速。在你所在地点的一个非弱点、非[[精英]]敌人被躲避后打出。
将该敌人混洗入遭遇牌库。

01084.name: 运气好！
01084.text:
Fast. Play when you would fail a skill test.
Get +2 to your skill value for that test. Draw 1 card.
01084.textZh:
快速。在你技能检定将要失败时打出。
该次检定你得到技能值+2。抽取1张卡牌。

01085.name: 生存意志
01085.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Until the end of your turn, do not reveal chaos tokens for any skill tests you perform.
01085.textZh:
快速。只能在你回合期间打出。
你执行的所有技能检定都不揭示混乱记，直到你回合结束。

01086.name: 刀子
01086.text:
[action]: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack.
[action] Discard Knife: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage.
01086.textZh:
[action]：攻击。你本次攻击得到+1[combat]。
[action]弃掉刀子：攻击。你本次攻击得到+2[combat]。本次攻击造成+1伤害。

01087.name: 手电筒
01087.text:
Uses (3 supplies).
[action] Spend 1 supply: Investigate. Your location gets -2 shroud for this investigation.
01087.textZh:
使用(3补给)。
[action]花费1补给：调查。本次调查期间，你所在地点隐藏值-2。

01088.flavor: You can never be too prepared.
01088.name: 应急物品

01089.name: 胆识
01089.text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test is successful, draw 1 card.
01089.textZh:
每次技能检定最多投入1张。
如果本次检定成功，抽取1张卡牌。

01090.name: 洞察力
01090.text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test is successful, draw 1 card.
01090.textZh:
每次技能检定最多投入1张。
如果本次检定成功，抽取1张卡牌。

01091.name: 压制
01091.text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test is successful, draw 1 card.
01091.textZh:
每次技能检定最多投入1张。
如果本次检定成功，抽取1张卡牌。

01092.name: 心灵手巧
01092.text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test is successful, draw 1 card.
01092.textZh:
每次技能检定最多投入1张。
如果本次检定成功，抽取1张卡牌。

01093.flavor: Sometimes, the most selfless acts can come from the strangest places
01093.flavorZh: 有时候，最意想不到的地方会有最无私的举动。
01093.name: 绝处逢生
01093.textZh: 每次技能检定最多投入1张。

01094.flavor: Bullets are one thing... twelve-inch fangs quite another.
01094.flavorZh: 子弹是一回事，十二英寸长的尖牙又是另一回事了。
01094.name: 防弹衣

01095.flavor: This has been in my family for generations. Take care of it, and it will take care of you.
01095.flavorZh: 这东西在我家里代代相传。好好关照它，它也会好好关照你的。
01095.name: 远古印记护身符

01096.flavor: Wait... where am I? What was I doing?
01096.name: 失忆
01096.text: Revelation - Choose and discard all but 1 card from your hand.
01096.textZh: 显现 - 选择并弃掉你的手牌，只剩1张。

01097.name: 妄想症
01097.textZh: 显现 - 弃掉你全部资源。

01098.name: 恶灵附身
01098.text:
Revelation - Add Haunted to your threat area.
You get -1 to each of your skills.
[action] [action]: Discard Haunted.
01098.textZh:
显现 - 将恶灵附身加入你的威胁区域。
你得到每项技能-1。
[action][action]：弃掉恶灵附身。

01099.name: 神经紊乱
01099.text:
Revelation - Add Psychosis to your threat area.
Forced - After you take 1 or more horror: Take 1 direct damage.
[action] [action]: Discard Psychosis.
01099.textZh:
显现 - 将神经紊乱加入你的威胁区域。
强制 - 你受到恐惧后：受到1点直接伤害。
[action][action]：弃掉神经紊乱。

01100.name: 忧郁症
01100.text:
Revelation - Add Hypochondria to your threat area.
Forced - After you take 1 or more damage: Take 1 direct horror.
[action] [action]: Discard Hypochondria.
01100.textZh:
显现 - 将忧郁症加入你的威胁区域。
强制 - 你受到伤害后：受到1点直接恐惧。
[action][action]：弃掉忧郁症。

01101.flavor: You knew you shouldn't have borrowed money from the O'Bannion gang. It seems like they're always looking to collect at the worst times.
01101.flavorZh: 你知道自己不该跟欧巴尼恩帮借钱的。看起来他们总是挑你最糟的时候收债。
01101.name: 黑帮打手
01101.text:
Prey - Bearer only.
Hunter.
[action] Spend 4 resources: Parley. Discard Mob Enforcer.
01101.textZh:
猎物 - 仅对承受者。
猎手。
[action] 花费4资源：谈判。弃掉黑帮打手。

01102.flavor: You'll never forget the day you learned the true secret of the Silver Twilight Lodge's inner circle. The truth is too terrible for the Lodge to let you live.
01102.flavorZh: 你永远也忘不了，自己得知银暮秘社核心圈真正秘密的那一天。这真相太过可怕，秘社不会任你活着。
01102.name: 银暮秘社僧侣
01102.text:
Prey - Bearer only.
Hunter.
Forced - After Silver Twilight Acolyte attacks: Place 1 doom on the current agenda.
01102.textZh:
猎物 - 仅对承受者。
猎手。
强制 - 在银暮秘社僧侣攻击后：在当前密谋上放置1个毁灭标记。

01103.flavor: Despite everything, he still won't believe you had nothing to do with those murders.
01103.flavorZh: 费尽口舌，他还是觉得你跟这些谋杀案有关。
01103.name: 固执的侦探
01103.text:
Prey - Bearer only.
Hunter.
While Stubborn Detective is at your location, treat your investigator as if his or her printed text box were blank (except for [[Traits]]).
01103.textZh:
猎物 - 仅对承受者。
猎手。
固执的侦探和你位于同一地点时，将你的调查员视为印刷文本框如同空白([[特性]]除外)。

01117.name: 丽塔·钱德勒
01117.text:
While you control Lita Chantler, she gains:
"Each investigator at your location gets +1 [combat].
[reaction] When an investigator at your location successfully attacks a [[Monster]] enemy: That investigator deals +1 damage."
01117.textZh:
你控制丽塔·钱德勒时，她获得：
“每位在你所在地点的调查员得到+1[combat]。
[reaction]在一位你所在地点的调查员成功攻击一个[[怪物]]敌人时：该调查员造成+1伤害。”

02001.backFlavor: Zoey had known that she was special ever since God spoke to her one night when she was six years old... the night that terrible fire took away her parents. He told her that He had chosen her from among all the people of the world to be His agent. She would protect the innocent and punish the wicked. Since then, He comes to her in times of trouble, offering guidance and comfort. Zoey now travels from city to city, taking work as a chef to support herself. When she isn't working, she stalks the night, guided by the Lord's voice. Wherever she finds wickedness, she strikes it down without remorse or hesitation.
02001.backFlavorZh: 在六岁那一晚，佐伊听到了上帝对她说话，她由此得知自己与众不同……就是在那一晚，大火夺走了她的父母。上帝告诉佐伊，已经在茫茫众生之中选中了她作为自己的使徒。她将保护无辜、惩处奸恶。自那以后，每次她身陷困局，主都会及时出现，指引她、抚慰她。佐伊现在穿行于各个城市之间，以主厨为业。不上班的时候，她就遵循主的声音，穿行于暗夜。只要发现奸恶，她必予以痛击，毫不心软，亦无犹豫。
02001.backText:
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to five other level 0 cards from any other class.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Zoey's Cross, Smite the Wicked, 1 random basic weakness.
02001.backTextZh:
牌库卡牌张数：30。
牌库构建选项：守卫者卡牌([guardian])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，所有其他职阶的卡牌([seeker]、[rogue]、[mystic]和/或[survivor])等级0最多5张。
牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：佐伊的十字架、击退邪恶、1张随机基础弱点。

deckOptions.error: You cannot have more than 5 cards that are not Guardian or Neutral

02001.flavor: "God has spoken. I will do His work without hesitation."
02001.flavorZh: “主已发话。我将毫不犹豫，完成他的大业。”
02001.name: 佐伊·萨马拉斯
02001.text:
[reaction] After you become engaged with an enemy: Gain 1 resource.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. If this skill test is successful during an attack, that attack deals +1 damage.
02001.textZh:
[reaction]在你和一个敌人交战后：获得1资源。
[elder_sign]效果：+1。如果攻击期间本次技能检定成功，则本次攻击造成+1伤害。

02002.backFlavor: When disaster strikes, Rex Murphy is usually on hand, suffering the consequences. After spending a day with Rex, even the most hardened skeptic will concede that the man is cursed. Anytime he had a lead on a good story, something would go wrong. That business in Innsmouth with the photographs that had blown out to sea. The tracks in Dunwich that had washed away in the rain just before he'd brought the sheriff. His terrible fortune has more than once exposed him to gruesome beasts and occult conspiracies. To survive, Rex has developed an inquisitive mind, keeping one step ahead of the next disaster.
02002.backFlavorZh: 每每灾祸来临，雷克斯·墨菲总是首当其冲。只要和雷克斯待上一天，哪怕是最坚定的无神论者都会坚信，这个男人一定是被诅咒了。每次一有好报道的苗头，事情就开始不对劲了。印斯茅斯的记录和照片一起都吹到了海里。在敦威治的时候，他刚要报警，路上的踪迹就被雨水冲得一干二净。这糟糕的运气已经不止一次让他直面可怕的野兽和密教的阴谋。为了活下去，雷克斯不得不拥有一颗好奇善问的心，让自己赶在下一场灾祸的前头。
02002.backText:
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to five other level 0 cards from any other class.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Search for the Truth, Rex's Curse, 1 random basic weakness.
Deckbuilding Restrictions: No [[Fortune]] cards.
02002.backTextZh:
牌库卡牌张数：30。
牌库构建选项：探求者卡牌([seeker])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，所有其他职阶的卡牌([guardian]、[rogue]、[mystic]和/或[survivor])等级0最多5张。
牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：寻找真相、雷克斯的诅咒、1张随机基础弱点。
牌库构建限制：无[[幸运]]卡牌。

deckOptions.error: You cannot have more than 5 cards that are not Seeker or Neutral

02002.flavor: "This time, nothing will stop me from getting at the truth!"
02002.flavorZh: “这次，什么都不能阻止我发现真相。”
02002.name: 雷克斯·墨菲
02002.text:
[reaction] After you succeed at a skill test by 2 or more while investigating: Discover 1 clue at your location.
[elder_sign] effect: +2. You may instead choose to automatically fail this skill test to draw 3 cards.
02002.textZh:
[reaction]你调查时技能检定成功且超过难度2点或更多后：发现你所在地点的1个线索。
[elder_sign]效果：+2。你可以改为选择本次技能检定自动失败，以抽取3张卡牌。

02003.backFlavor: Jenny Barnes has spent the majority of her young life in pursuit of creature comforts, fine dining, and the latest fashions. That all changed when she received a letter from her sister, Isabelle. In this letter, Isabelle confessed that mysterious forces were aligning against her and that she feared she may fall victim to some paranormal threat. It was the last letter Jenny received from her beloved sister. Jenny has since returned to the States to track down and investigate all occult occurrences she can find. Hardly a wilting flower, she has proven herself a crack shot as well as a fearless and clever investigator of the unknown. Until Isabelle's disappearance is explained, Jenny will never relent in her search.
02003.backFlavorZh: 珍妮·巴恩斯把自己的青春韶光都花在了追求物质享受、珍馐佳肴和新近时尚上。但自从她收到姐妹伊莎贝拉的来信之后，一切都变了。伊莎贝拉在信中坦露，神秘力量合起伙儿来对付她，她害怕自己就要沦入某种神秘力量的魔爪。这是珍妮从挚爱的姐妹那里收到的最后一封信。于是她回到了美国，追踪调查自己能发现的任何密教行迹。她已证明自己绝非温室里的花朵，一碰就枯，而是一位百发百中的神枪手，一位勇敢无畏、绝顶聪明、挺身面向未知的调查员。找不到伊莎贝拉失踪的原因，珍妮的搜寻就绝不停止。
02003.backText:
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to five other level 0 cards from any other class.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Jenny's Twin .45s, Searching for Izzie, 1 random basic weakness.
02003.backTextZh:
牌库卡牌张数：30。
牌库构建选项：流浪者卡牌([rogue])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，所有其他职阶的卡牌([guardian]、[seeker]、[mystic]和/或[survivor])等级0最多5张。
牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：珍妮的.45双枪、寻找伊莎贝拉、1张随机基础弱点。

deckOptions.error: You cannot have more than 5 cards that are not Rogue or Neutral

02003.flavor: "No more 'Miss Barnes' from you. My friends call me Jenny."
02003.flavorZh: “别让我再听到你说什么‘巴恩斯小姐’了。朋友们都叫我珍妮。”
02003.name: 珍妮·巴恩斯
02003.text:
You collect 1 additional resource during each upkeep phase.
[elder_sign] effect: +1 for each resource you have.
02003.textZh:
你在每个补给阶段期间获取额外1资源。
[elder_sign]效果：你每有1个资源，+1。

02004.backFlavor: Jazz has been nothing but trouble for Jim since the day he picked up his daddy's trumpet. There was something weird and otherworldly about the writing on the inside of the bell, but the tones from it were smooth and dark, like good coffee. That trumpet landed Jim a lot of gigs until the time it made Widow Jenkins get up and dance, the day he played at her funeral. After that, it was kind of hard to find work. Since then, Jim has learned a lot about jazz - and the things the graveyard ghouls talk about on cold autumn nights. Lately, they've been talking about The End, as in the end of everything that is and could be. The Final Rhapsody. The fact is, Jim isn't too keen on that idea.
02004.backFlavorZh: 自打吉姆拿起父亲的小号那天，爵士乐对他来说就只剩下了麻烦。喇叭里面奇怪的雕文看起来像是异界文字，里面吹出的曲调也醇厚而暗黑，仿佛一杯浓咖啡。这把小号给吉姆召来了不少活计，直到寡妇詹金斯听了他的演奏跳起来手舞足蹈——那天恰是寡妇的葬礼。打那以后，吉姆就很难找到活了。他深入学习了更多有关爵士乐的事情——以及墓地食尸鬼在寒秋之夜谈论的东西。近来它们都在谈论“终末”，也就是现有万物和未来一起的终结。最后的狂想曲。其实，吉姆并不太喜欢这个。
02004.backText:
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Mystic cards ([mystic]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to five other level 0 cards from any other class.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Jim's Trumpet, Final Rhapsody, 1 random basic weakness.
02004.backTextZh:
牌库卡牌张数：30。
牌库构建选项：潜修者卡牌([mystic])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，所有其他职阶的卡牌([guardian]、[seeker]、[rogue]和/或[survivor])等级0最多5张。
牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：吉姆的小号、最后的狂想曲、1张随机基础弱点。

deckOptions.error: You cannot have more than 5 cards that are not Mystic or Neutral

02004.flavor: "No, not quiet at all. Dead folks get downright rambunctious when I play my horn."
02004.flavorZh: “不，完全不是。只要我一吹号，亡者就会狂乱不已。”
02004.name: 吉姆·卡尔弗
02004.text:
Treat the modifier on [skull] tokens you reveal as "0."
Anytime you reveal a [elder_sign] token, you may choose to instead treat it as a [skull] token.
[elder_sign] effect: +1.
02004.textZh:
将你揭示的[skull]标记的修正值视为“0”。
你每次揭示[elder_sign]标记，你可以选择改为将其视作[skull]标记。
[elder_sign]效果：+1。

02005.backFlavor: At night, "Ashcan" Pete sleeps wherever his travels take him: in a field, on a train, or maybe, if he's lucky, in a barn. He bunks with his loyal hound dog, Duke, on one side and his beat-up guitar on the other. And sometimes when Pete sleeps, he dreams. He dreams of haunted, tortured places and of horrible creatures. When he wakes up, he knows that someone needs his help, because his dreams are true. He could not say how long he has been on the road, living by his wits, but he can say for certain no place is too far to go to help someone in need. And as long as Pete can help people, he is not likely to stop wandering any time soon.
02005.backFlavorZh: “灰堆”皮特一路流浪，晚上走到哪里就睡在哪里：田野间，火车上，运气好的话则是谷仓里。他身边睡着自己忠实的猎犬——杜克，另一边则是自己的旧吉他。皮特睡着的时候，有时会做梦。他梦到恶灵萦绕、饱受折磨的地方，梦到可怕的怪物。每每醒来之时，他知道有人需要帮助，因为他的梦境绝非虚假。他不知道自己凭着机智已经走了多久，但他确定只要有人需要帮助，任何地方都无法弗届。只要皮特还能对别人施以援手，他就会一直流浪下去。
02005.backText:
Deck Size: 30.
Deckbuilding Options: Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to five other level 0 cards from any other class.
Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Duke, Wracked by Nightmares, 1 random basic weakness.
02005.backTextZh:
牌库卡牌张数：30。
牌库构建选项：求生者卡牌([survivor])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，所有其他职阶的卡牌([guardian]、[seeker]、[rogue]和/或[mystic])等级0最多5张。
牌库构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)：杜克、噩梦来袭、1张随机基础弱点。

02005.flavor: "C'mere, boy. We got work to do."
02005.name: “灰堆”皮特
02005.text:
You begin the game with Duke in play.
[fast] Discard a card from your hand: Ready an asset you control. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +2. Ready Duke.
02005.textZh:
你以杜克在场上开始游戏。
[free]弃掉你一张手牌：重整你控制的一个支援。(每轮仅限一次。)
[elder_sign]效果：+2。重整杜克。

02006.name: 佐伊的十字架
02006.text:
Zoey Samaras deck only.
[reaction] After an enemy becomes engaged with you, exhaust Zoey's Cross and spend 1 resource: Deal 1 damage to that enemy.
02006.textZh:
佐伊·萨马拉斯牌库专用。
[reaction]一个敌人与你交战后，横置佐伊的十字架并花费1资源：对该敌人造成1点伤害。

02007.name: 击退邪恶
02007.text:
Revelation - Discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until an enemy is discarded. Attach Smite the Wicked to that enemy and spawn it at the location farthest from you.
Forced - When the game ends, if attached enemy is in play: Zoey Samaras suffers 1 mental trauma.
02007.textZh:
显现 - 从遭遇牌库顶弃牌，直到弃掉一个敌人。将击退邪恶附属到该敌人上，并将其生成在离你最远的地点。
强制 - 在游戏结束时，如果所附属的敌人在场上：佐伊·萨马拉斯承受1点精神创伤。

02008.flavor: When things went his way, which wasn't often these days, Rex was a good reporter, with a nose for a story and an eye for detail... <cite>Graham McNeill, Ghouls of the Miskatonic,</cite>
02008.flavorZh: 一切尚在正轨，不像现在这么常常作妖的时候，雷克斯还算得上是位好记者，既对新闻非常敏感，又能抓住细节……格雷厄姆·麦克尼尔，《米斯卡塔尼克的食尸鬼》
02008.name: 寻找真相
02008.text:
Rex Murphy deck only.
Draw X cards, where X is the number of clues on Rex Murphy (to a maximum of 5).
02008.textZh:
雷克斯·墨菲牌库专用。
抽取X张卡牌，其中X为雷克斯·墨菲的线索数(最多为5)。

02009.name: 雷克斯的诅咒
02009.text:
Revelation - Put Rex's Curse into play in your threat area.
Forced - When you would succeed at a skill test: Return the revealed chaos token to the bag and reveal a new chaos token. If this effect causes you to fail the test, shuffle Rex's Curse into your deck. (Limit once per test.)
02009.textZh:
显现 - 将雷克斯的诅咒放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。
强制 - 在你技能检定将要成功时：将揭示的混乱标记放回混乱袋，并揭示一个新的混乱标记。如果本效果导致你该检定失败，将雷克斯的诅咒混洗入你的牌库。(每次检定仅限一次。)

02010.flavor: "...Say, are those Mr. Donohue's guns?" Jenny held a pistol over her shoulder and struck a pose. "I think they suit me better than him. Don't you agree?"
02010.flavorZh:
“……你说，这是多诺万先生的枪？”
珍妮举枪过肩，摆了个姿势，
“但我觉得它们更适合我。你不这么觉得吗？”
02010.name: 珍妮的.45双枪
02010.text:
Jenny Barnes deck only. Uses (X ammo).
[action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage.
02010.textZh:
珍妮·巴恩斯牌库专用。使用(X子弹)。
[action]花费1子弹：攻击。本次攻击你得到+2[combat]。本次攻击造成+1伤害。

02011.name: 寻找伊莎贝拉
02011.text:
Revelation - Attach Searching for Izzie to the location farthest from you.
[action] [action]: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, discard Searching for Izzie.
Forced - When the game ends, if Searching for Izzie is in play: Jenny Barnes suffers 1 mental trauma.
02011.textZh:
显现 - 将寻找伊莎贝拉附属到离你最远的地点。
[action][action]：调查。如果你检定成功，不发现线索，改为弃掉寻找伊莎贝拉。
强制 - 在游戏结束时，如果寻找伊莎贝拉在场上：珍妮·巴恩斯承受1点精神创伤。

02012.flavor: Daddy used to say, "Jazz is a lot like liquor, it makes everything go down a little smoother." Daddy used to say a lot of stupid things.
02012.flavorZh: 爸爸过去常说：“爵士乐如酒，能让任何事情都变得顺利点儿。”爸爸过去真是说了不少蠢话。
02012.name: 吉姆的小号
02012.text:
Jim Culver deck only.
[reaction] When a [skull] token is revealed during a skill test, exhaust Jim's Trumpet: Heal 1 horror from an investigator at your location or a connecting location.
02012.textZh:
吉姆·卡尔弗牌库专用。
[reaction]在技能检定期间揭示[skull]标记时，横置吉姆的小号：治愈你所在地点或连接地点的一位调查员1点恐惧。

02013.flavor: When the dead start talking about what scares them, that's when it's time to listen.
02013.flavorZh: 要是连亡者都开始谈论它们害怕的东西，那真该好好听听了。
02013.name: 最后的狂想曲
02013.text: Revelation - Reveal 5 chaos tokens from the chaos bag. For each [skull] and [auto_fail] token revealed, take 1 damage and 1 horror.
02013.textZh: 显现 - 从混乱袋中揭示5个混乱标记。每揭示一个[skull]或[auto_fail]标记，受到1点伤害和1点恐惧。

02014.name: 杜克
02014.text:
"Ashcan" Pete deck only.
[action] Exhaust Duke: Fight. You attack with a base [combat] skill of 4. This attack deals +1 damage.
[action] Exhaust Duke: Investigate. You investigate with a base [intellect] skill of 4. You may move to a connecting location immediately before investigating with this effect.
02014.textZh:
“灰堆”皮特牌库专用。
[action]横置杜克：攻击。你以基础值为4的[combat]攻击。本次攻击造成+1伤害。
[action]横置杜克：调查。你以基础值为4的[intellect]调查。你可以在以本效果调查前立刻移动到一个连接地点。

02015.name: 噩梦来袭
02015.text:
Revelation - Exhaust all assets you control and put Wracked by Nightmares into play in your threat area.
Assets you control cannot ready.
[action] [action]: Discard Wracked by Nightmares.
02015.textZh:
显现 - 横置你控制的所有支援，并将噩梦来袭放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。
你控制的支援不能重整。
[action][action]：弃掉噩梦来袭。

02016.name: 金属棍棒
02016.text: [action]: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack. If you perform this attack against an enemy engaged with another investigator and you fail, you deal no damage.
02016.textZh: [action]：攻击。本次攻击你得到+1[combat]。如果你对与另一位调查员交战的敌人执行本次攻击，且你检定失败，则你不造成伤害。

02017.flavor: You steel your nerves and shout into the darkness. "Come and get me!"
02017.flavorZh: 你鼓起勇气，朝黑暗中大喊：“来抓我啊！”
02017.name: 嘲讽
02017.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Engage any number of enemies at your location.
02017.textZh:
快速。只能在你回合期间打出。
与你所在地点任意数量的敌人交战。

02018.name: 团队合作
02018.text: Investigators at your location may give or trade any number of [[Item]] assets, [[Ally]] assets, or resources among one another.
02018.textZh: 你所在地点的调查员彼此之间可以给出或交易任意数量的[[道具]]支援、[[盟友]]支援或资源。

02019.flavor: You steel your nerves and shout into the darkness. "Come and get me!"
02019.flavorZh: 你鼓起勇气，朝黑暗中大喊：“来抓我啊！”
02019.name: 嘲讽
02019.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Engage any number of enemies at your location. Draw 1 card for each enemy engaged in this way.
02019.textZh:
快速。只能在你回合期间打出。
与你所在地点任意数量的敌人交战。你每以此方式与一个敌人交战，抽取1张卡牌。

02020.name: 实验室助理
02020.text:
Your maximum hand size is increased by 2.
[reaction] After Laboratory Assistant enters play: Draw 2 cards.
02020.textZh:
你的手牌上限增加2张。
[reaction]实验室助理入场后：抽取2张卡牌。

02021.flavor: By all accounts, it should not even exist.
02021.flavorZh: 无论从什么方面来看，这东西都不该存在。
02021.name: 奇怪的溶液
02021.text: [action] Test [intellect] (4). If you succeed, discard Strange Solution and draw 2 cards. Record in your Campaign Log that "you have identified the solution."
02021.textZh: [action]：检定[intellect](4)。如果你检定成功，弃掉奇怪的溶液并抽取2张卡牌。在剧本日志里记录“你确认了溶液的成分。”

02022.flavor: You know this town like the back of your hand.
02022.flavorZh: 你对这座城镇了若指掌。
02022.name: 捷径
02022.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Choose an investigator at your location. Move that investigator to a connecting location.
02022.textZh:
快速。只能在你回合期间打出。
选择你所在地点的1位调查员。将该调查员移动到一个连接地点。

02023.flavor: Some people need to know the truth at any cost. Some truths can cut like knives.
02023.flavorZh: 有人不惜一切代价也要知道真相。但有些真相比利刃更伤人。
02023.name: 寻找答案
02023.text: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering a clue at your location, discover a clue at a connecting location.
02023.textZh: 调查。如果你检定成功，不发现你所在地点的1个线索，改为在一个连接地点发现1个线索。

02024.name: 酒胆
02024.text:
Uses (4 supplies).
[action] Spend 1 supply: Choose an investigator at your location to heal 1 horror. Then, that investigator tests [willpower] (2). If the test succeeds, he or she heals 1 additional horror. If the test fails, he or she discards 1 card at random from his or her hand.
02024.textZh:
使用(4补给)。
[action]花费1补给：选择你所在地点的1位调查员治愈1点恐惧。然后，该调查员检定[willpower](2)。如果检定成功，其治愈额外1点恐惧。如果检定失败，其随机弃掉自己1张手牌。

02025.name: 逃跑本能
02025.text:
Fast. Play when an enemy would spawn at your location.
Immediately move to a connecting location. (The enemy still spawns at your previous location.)
02025.textZh:
快速。在一个敌人将要生成在你的地点时打出。
立刻移动到一个连接地点。(该敌人依然生成在你先前地点。)

02026.name: 赌一把
02026.text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
Double the difficulty of this skill test. If this skill test is successful, resolve the effects of the successful test twice.
02026.textZh:
每次技能检定最多投入1张。
本次技能检定难度翻倍。如果本次技能检定成功，结算检定成功效果两次。

02027.name: 雇佣打手
02027.text:
You get +1 [combat].
Forced - At the end of the upkeep phase: You must either pay 1 resource or discard Hired Muscle.
02027.textZh:
你得到+1[combat]。
强制 - 当补给阶段结束时：你必须支付1资源或弃掉雇佣打手。

02028.name: 礼寻术
02028.text:
Uses (3 charges).
[action] Spend 1 charge: Investigate. Investigate using [willpower] instead of [intellect]. If you succeed, discover 1 additional clue at this location. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this test, after this test resolves lose all remaining actions and immediately end your turn.
02028.textZh:
使用(3充能)。
[action]花费1充能：调查。本次调查不使用[intellect]，改为使用[willpower]。如果你检定成功，发现所在地点额外1个线索。如果本次检定期间揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，本次检定结算后，失去所有剩余的行动，立即结束你的回合。

02029.flavor: The wax tapers give off an eerie glow, and the flames move as if they are alive.
02029.name: 仪式蜡烛
02029.text: [reaction] After a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing] symbol is revealed during a test you are performing: You get +1 skill value for this test.
02029.textZh: [reaction]你执行的技能检定期间揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]或[elder_thing]符号后：你本次检定得到技能值+1。

02030.flavor:
From the unreal lead me to the real
From the darkness lead me to the light
From the dead lead me to the immortal
02030.flavorZh:
虚幻带来现实
黑暗带来光明
死亡带来永恒
02030.name: 净心术
02030.text:
Uses (3 charges).
[action] Spend 1 charge: Heal 1 horror from an investigator at your location.
02030.textZh:
使用(3充能)。
[action]花费1充能：治愈你所在地点一位调查员1点恐惧。

02031.name: 困兽之笼
02031.text:
Evade. This evasion attempt uses [willpower] instead of [agility]. If you succeed and the enemy is non‑[[Elite]], evade it and attach Bind Monster to it.
[reaction] When attached enemy would ready: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, attached enemy does not ready. If you fail, discard Bind Monster.
02031.textZh:
躲避。本次躲避尝试不使用[agility]，改为使用[willpower]。如果你检定成功且该敌人非[[精英]]，躲避该敌人并将困兽之笼附属到该敌人。
[reaction]在附属的敌人将要重整时：检定[willpower](3)。如果你检定成功，附属的敌人不重整。如果你检定失败，弃掉困兽之笼。

02032.name: 消防斧
02032.text:
[action]: Fight. If you have no resources in your resource pool, this attack deals +1 damage.
[fast] During an attack using Fire Axe, spend 1 resource: You get +2 [combat] for this skill test. (Limit three times per attack.)
02032.textZh:
[action]：攻击。如果你的资源池中没有资源，本次攻击造成+1伤害。
[free]在使用消防斧的攻击期间，花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+2[combat]。(每次攻击仅限三次。)

02033.flavor: The broad-shouldered young man exudes the sort of confidence one only finds in youth.
02033.flavorZh: 这个宽肩小伙子散发着一种年轻人才有的自信。
02033.name: 彼得·希尔维斯特
02033.text:
You get +1 [agility].
[reaction] After your turn ends: Heal 1 horror from Peter Sylvestre.
02033.textZh:
你得到+1[agility]。
[reaction]在你的回合结束后：治愈彼得·希尔维斯特的1点恐惧。

02034.name: 偷梁换柱
02034.text: Evade. If you succeed, if the enemy is non-[[Elite]], evade the enemy and move it to a connecting location.
02034.textZh: 躲避。如果你检定成功，且躲避的敌人非[[精英]]，躲避该敌人并将其移动到一个连接地点。

02035.flavor: The broad-shouldered young man exudes the sort of confidence one only finds in youth.
02035.flavorZh: 这个宽肩小伙子散发着一种年轻人才有的自信。
02035.name: 彼得·希尔维斯特
02035.text:
You get +1 [agility] and +1 [willpower].
[reaction] After your turn ends: Heal 1 horror from Peter Sylvestre.
02035.textZh:
你得到+1[agility]和+1[willpower]。
[reaction]在你的回合结束后：治愈彼得·希尔维斯特的1点恐惧。

02036.name: 弯刀
02036.text: [action]: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack. If you succeed, you may spend 1 additional action to deal +1 damage for this attack.
02036.textZh: [action]：攻击。本次攻击你得到+1[combat]。如果你检定成功，你可以花费额外1个行动以使本次攻击造成+1伤害。

02037.flavor: One man's loan is another man's treasure.
02037.name: 负债
02037.text:
Permanent.
You start each game with 2 fewer resources.
02037.textZh:
永久。
你以少2资源开始每场游戏。

02038.name: 内伤
02038.text:
Revelation - Place Internal Injury into play in your threat area.
Forced - At the end of your turn: Take 1 direct damage.
[action] [action]: Discard Internal Injury.
02038.textZh:
显现 - 将内伤放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。
强制 - 当你的回合结束时：受到1点直接伤害。
[action][action]：弃掉内伤。

02039.name: 时间恐惧症
02039.text:
Revelation - Place Chronophobia into play in your threat area.
Forced - At the end of your turn: Take 1 direct horror.
[action] [action]: Discard Chronophobia.
02039.textZh:
显现 - 将时间恐惧症放置入场，放到你的威胁区域。
强制 - 当你的回合结束时：受到1点直接恐惧。
[action][action]：弃掉时间恐惧症。

02105.name: 紧急救援
02105.text: Choose an investigator at your location. Heal 2 damage from that investigator or from an [[Ally]] asset he or she controls.
02105.textZh: 选择你所在地点的1位调查员。治愈该调查员或其控制的一个[[盟友]]支援的2点伤害。

02106.name: 弟兄塞维尔
02106.text:
You get +1 [willpower].
Brother Xavier may be assigned damage and/or horror dealt to other investigators at your location.
[reaction] When Brother Xavier is defeated: Deal 2 damage to an enemy at your location.
02106.textZh:
你得到+1[willpower]。
对你所在地点其他调查员造成的伤害和/或恐惧，可以分配给弟兄塞维尔。
[reaction]在弟兄塞维尔被击败时：对你所在地点的一个敌人造成2点伤害。

02107.flavor: "That's the worst plan I've ever heard. Well, what are we waiting for?"
02107.flavorZh: “那真是我听过最烂的计划。好吧，那我们还在等什么？”
02107.name: “我有个计划！”
02107.text: Fight. This attack uses [intellect]. You deal +1 damage for this attack for each clue you have (max +3 damage).
02107.textZh: 攻击。本次攻击使用[intellect]。你每有一个线索，本次攻击造成+1伤害(最多+3伤害)。

02108.flavor: Searchers after horror haunt strange, far places. - H. P. Lovecraft, "The Picture in the House"
02108.flavorZh: 追寻恐怖者逡巡于诡奇偏远之地。H.P.洛夫克拉夫特，《屋中画》
02108.name: 探路者
02108.text: [fast] During your turn, if you are not engaged with any enemies, exhaust Pathfinder: Move to a connecting location.
02108.textZh: [free]在你回合期间，如果你未与任何敌人交战，横置探路者：移动到一个连接地点。

02109.flavor: It may not be legal, but it gets the job done.
02109.flavorZh: 这可能并不合法，但却能办成事。
02109.name: 走私品
02109.text: Choose an asset controlled by an investigator at your location. Double the number of ammo or supply tokens on that asset.
02109.textZh: 选择你所在地点一位调查员控制的一个支援。将该支援上的子弹或补给标记数量翻倍。

02110.name: 适应性
02110.text:
Permanent.
In between each game of a campaign, you may swap up to two level 0 cards out of your deck in exchange for an equal number of level 0 cards. (You must still follow all deckbuilding rules for your investigator).
02110.textZh:
永久。
在一个剧本的每场游戏间，你可以将你牌库中最多两张等级0的卡牌换为同等数量的等级0卡牌。(你仍然必须遵守你调查员的牌库构建规则)。

02111.flavor: Some things, once seen, can't be unseen.
02111.flavorZh: 有些东西一旦看见就无法忽视。
02111.name: 过度深入
02111.text: In player order, each investigator draws 1 card from the top of the encounter deck. Then, add Delve Too Deep to the victory display.
02111.textZh: 按玩家顺序，每位调查员抽取遭遇牌库顶的1张卡牌。然后，将过度深入加入胜利区。

02112.name: 死亡之歌
02112.text:
Uses (5 charges).
[action] Spend 1 charge: Fight. This attack uses [willpower] instead of [combat]. You get +1 [willpower] for this attack. If a [skull] symbol is revealed during this attack, this attack deals +2 damage.
02112.textZh:
使用(5充能)。
[action]花费1充能：攻击。本次攻击不使用[combat]，改为使用[willpower]。你本次攻击得到+1[willpower]。如果本次攻击期间揭示了[skull]符号，本次攻击造成+2伤害。

02113.name: 哎呀！
02113.text:
Fast. Play after you fail a skill test by 2 or less while attacking an enemy engaged with you.
Deal this attack's damage to a different enemy at your location.
02113.textZh:
快速。在你攻击与你交战的敌人时技能检定失败，并且低于难度2点及以内后打出。
对你所在地点的另一个敌人造成本次攻击的伤害。

02114.name: 灭火器
02114.text:
[action]: Fight. You get +1 [combat] for this attack.
[action] Exile Fire Extinguisher: Evade. You get +3 [agility] for this test. If you are successful, evade each other enemy engaged with you, as well.
02114.textZh:
[action]：攻击。你本次攻击得到+1[combat]。
[action]放逐灭火器：躲避。你本次检定得到+3[agility]。如果你检定成功，也躲避与你交战的其他每个敌人。

02115.name: 照明弹
02115.text:
Either (choose one):
- Fight. You get +3 [combat] and deal +2 damage for this attack. Exile Flare.
- Search the top 9 cards of any investigator's deck for an [[Ally]] asset and put it into play under your control. Then, exile Flare. Shuffle the searched deck.
02115.textZh:
选择一项：
- 攻击。本次攻击你得到+3[combat]并造成+2伤害。放逐照明弹。
- 查找任意调查员牌库顶9张卡牌，找出一个[[盟友]]支援并将其放置入场，放到你的控制之下。然后，放逐照明弹。混洗查找过的牌库。

02116.flavor: A good pipe can calm the most frazzled of nerves.
02116.name: 烟斗
02116.text:
Uses (3 supplies).
[fast] Spend 1 supply, exhaust Smoking Pipe, and take 1 damage: Heal 1 horror.
02116.textZh:
使用(3补给)。
[free]花费1补给，横置烟斗，并受到1点伤害：治愈1点恐惧。

02117.flavor: Do not exceed the recommended dosage.
02117.flavorZh: 止痛药虽好，可不要贪吃哦。
02117.name: 止痛药
02117.text:
Uses (3 supplies).
[fast] Spend 1 supply, exhaust Painkillers, and take 1 horror: Heal 1 damage.
02117.textZh:
使用(3补给)。
[free]花费1补给，横置止痛药，并受到1点恐惧：治愈1点伤害。

02147.name: 子弹袋
02147.text: You have 1 additional hand slot, which can only be used to hold a [[Weapon]] asset.
02147.textZh: 你拥有额外1个手部槽位，只可以用来携带[[武器]]支援。

02148.flavor: They won't take us down that easily!
02148.name: 团结一致
02148.text: Choose another investigator at your location. Both you and that investigator draw 2 cards and gain 2 resources.
02148.textZh: 选择你所在地点的另一位调查员。你和该调查员都抽取2张卡牌并获得2资源。

02149.name: 艺术生
02149.text: [reaction] After Art Student enters play: Discover 1 clue at your location.
02149.textZh: [reaction]在艺术生入场后：发现你所在地点的1个线索。

02150.flavor: I knew I had seen this symbol before. I must warn the others before it is too late!
02150.flavorZh: 我知道我看过这个符号。我必须赶在一切太迟之前警告其他人！
02150.name: 推理
02150.text: If this skill test is successful while investigating a location, discover 1 additional clue at that location (2 additional clues instead if it succeeds by 2 or more).
02150.textZh: 如果调查一个地点时本技能检定成功，额外发现该地点的1个线索(如果检定成功且超过难度2点或更多，则改为额外2个线索)。

02151.flavor: Quitters may never win, but they also rarely die.
02151.flavorZh: 半途而废可能不会赢，但也很少死。
02151.name: “我要走了！”
02151.text:
Play only if there is a scenario card with a 'resign' ability in play.
Resign. You get the hell out of here.
02151.textZh:
场上有冒险卡带有“撤退”能力才能打出。
撤退。你逃出了这个鬼地方。

02152.name: 弹簧刀
02152.text:
Fast.
[action] Fight. You get +2 [combat] for this attack. If you succeed by 2 or more, this attack deals +1 damage.
02152.textZh:
快速。
[action]：攻击。本次攻击你得到+2[combat]。如果你检定成功且超过难度至少2点，本次攻击造成+1伤害。

02153.name: 催眠术
02153.text:
Fast. Play when an enemy attacks an investigator at your location.
Cancel that attack. Then, reveal a random token from the chaos bag. If it has a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol, deal the attacking enemy's damage to itself.
02153.textZh:
快速。在一个敌人攻击你所在地点的一位调查员时打出。
取消该次攻击。然后，从混乱袋中随机揭示一个标记。如果该标记有[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，对该敌人造成其自身的伤害。

02154.name: 皱缩术
02154.text:
Uses (4 charges).
[action] Spend one charge: Fight. This attack uses [willpower] instead of [combat]. You get +2 [willpower] and deal +1 damage for this attack. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this attack, take 1 horror.
02154.textZh:
使用(4充能)。
[action]花费1充能：攻击。本次攻击不使用[combat]，改为使用[willpower]。你本次攻击得到+2[willpower]并造成+1伤害。如果本次攻击期间揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，受到1点恐惧。

02155.flavor: There's nothing in the headlines about the horrors you've witnessed. But the obituaries section is disturbingly long.
02155.flavorZh: 头条里并未刊登你所见证的恐怖。但讣告栏里的名字却多得吓人。
02155.name: 报纸
02155.text: You get +2 [intellect] while investigating if you have no clues.
02155.textZh: 你调查时如果没有线索，得到+2[intellect]。

02156.name: 诱敌深入
02156.text:
Attach to your location.
 During the enemy phase, each enemy that moves does so along the shortest path toward the attached location, instead of to where it would normally move.
 Forced - While attached, at the end of the round: Discard Lure.
02156.textZh:
附属到你所在地点。
敌军阶段期间，所有要移动的敌人不照常移动，而是改为沿着最短路径，朝附属地点移动。
强制 - 附属在地点时，当一轮结束时：弃掉诱敌深入。

02157.flavor: No stone unturned, no ancient treasure left behind.
02157.flavorZh:
翻石破砖苦，殚精竭虑忙。
旧宝传千古，妙手一扫光。
02157.name: 宝物猎人
02157.text:
Permanent.
You have 1 additional accessory slot.
02157.textZh:
永久。
你拥有额外1个饰品槽位。

02158.flavor: When you turn on the charm, it could light the entire town.
02158.flavorZh: 魅力光芒万丈，全城为之闪亮。
02158.name: 魅力超凡
02158.text:
Permanent.
You have 1 additional ally slot.
02158.textZh:
永久。
你拥有额外1个盟友槽位。

02184.name: 最坏的打算
02184.text: Search the top 9 cards of your deck for a [[Weapon]] asset and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
02184.textZh: 查找你牌库顶的9张卡牌，找出1个[[武器]]支援，将其加入你的手牌。混洗你的牌库。

02185.name: 锐利目光
02185.text:
Permanent.
[fast] Spend 2 resources: You get +1 [intellect] until the end of the phase.
[fast] Spend 2 resources: You get +1 [combat] until the end of the phase.
02185.textZh:
永久。
[free]花费2资源：你得到+1[intellect]，直到本阶段结束。
[free]花费2资源：你得到+1[combat]，直到本阶段结束。

02186.name: 荒唐的素描像
02186.text:
Play only if there is a clue on your location.
Draw 3 cards.
02186.textZh:
你的地点有线索才能打出。
抽取3张卡牌。

02187.name: 高等教育
02187.text:
Permanent.
While you have 5 or more cards in your hand, Higher Education gains:
"[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +2 [willpower] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +2 [intellect] for this skill test."
02187.textZh:
永久。
你有至少5张手牌时，高等教育获得：
“[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+2[willpower]。
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+2[intellect]。”

02188.flavor: “I never mind being on my own. That’s when I do my best work.”
02188.flavorZh: “我不介意独自行事。这样我反而能做到最好。”
02188.name: 孤狼
02188.text:
Limit 1 per investigator.
[reaction] When your turn begins, if there are no other investigators at your location: Gain 1 resource.
02188.textZh:
每位调查员仅限1张。
[reaction]在你回合开始时，如果你所在地点没有其他调查员：获得1资源。

02189.name: 街头浪子
02189.text:
Permanent.
[fast] Spend 2 resources: You get +3 [intellect] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 2 resources: You get +3 [agility] for this skill test.
02189.textZh:
永久。
[free]花费2资源：你本次技能检定得到+3[intellect]。
[free]花费2资源：你本次技能检定得到+3[agility]。

02190.name: 逆反
02190.text: Before revealing chaos tokens for this test, choose one of the following symbols: ([skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing]). Ignore the effects of the chosen symbol during this test (including its modifier).
02190.textZh: 在本次检定揭示混乱标记前，选择以下一个符号：([skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]或[elder_thing])。本次检定期间忽略所选符号的效果(包括其修正值)。

02191.name: 鲜血盟约
02191.text:
Permanent.
[fast] Add 1 doom to Blood Pact: You get +3 [willpower] for this skill test. (Limit once per test.)
[fast] Add 1 doom to Blood Pact: You get +3 [combat] for this skill test. (Limit once per test.)
02191.textZh:
永久。
[free]在鲜血盟约上增加1个毁灭标记：你本次技能检定得到+3[willpower]。(每次检定仅限一次。)
[free]在鲜血盟约上增加1个毁灭标记：你本次技能检定得到+3[combat]。(每次检定仅限一次。)

02192.name: 随机应变
02192.text: Commit only to a skill test you are performing, and only if the difficulty of that test is at least 2 higher than your base skill value.
02192.textZh: 只能投入你正在执行，且难度高于你基础技能值至少2点的技能检定。

02193.name: 拳击家
02193.text:
Permanent.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [combat] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [agility] for this skill test.
02193.textZh:
永久。
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[combat]。
[free]花费1资源：你本次技能检定得到+1[agility]。

02194.flavor: You can never be too prepared.
02194.name: 应急物品
02194.textZh: 获得3资源并抽取1张卡牌。

02225.flavor: It's a small comfort, but you'll take it.
02225.flavorZh: 只是一次小小的激励，但你确实需要。
02225.name: “如果它会流血……”
02225.text:
Fast. Play after you defeat a [[Monster]] enemy.
Each investigator at your location heals horror equal to that enemy's horror value.
02225.textZh:
快速。在你击败一个[[怪物]]敌人后打出。
你所在地点的每位调查员治愈等于该敌人恐惧值的恐惧。

02226.name: 春田M1903
02226.text:
Uses (3 ammo).
[action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. You get +3 [combat] and deal +2 damage for this attack. Cannot be used to attack enemies engaged with you.
02226.textZh:
使用(3子弹)。
[action]花费1子弹：攻击。本次攻击你得到+3[combat]并造成+2伤害。不能用于攻击与你交战的敌人。

02227.flavor: If we wish to learn, we must first question everything we know.
02227.name: 追根究底
02227.text: Commit to a skill test only if there is a clue at your location.
02227.textZh: 你的地点有线索才能投入到技能检定。

02228.name: 暴露弱点
02228.text:
Fast. Play during any [fast] player window.
Choose an enemy at your location. Test [intellect] (X), where X is that enemy's fight value. For each point you succeed by, reduce that enemy's fight value by 1 for the next attack performed against it this phase.
02228.textZh:
快速。在任意[free]玩家时间段期间打出。
选择你所在地点的一个敌人。检定[intellect](X)，其中X等于该敌人的攻击值。你检定成功且每超过难度1点，本阶段对该敌人下次执行的攻击中，该敌人的攻击值降低1点。

02229.name: 思维敏捷
02229.text: If this skill test is successful by 2 or more, after it resolves, you may immediately take an action as if it were your turn (this action does not count toward the number of actions you can take each turn).
02229.textZh: 如果本次技能检定成功且超过难度2点或更多，在其结算后，你可以立即进行一个行动，如同在你的回合(该行动不计入你每回合可以进行的行动数)。

02230.name: 幸运骰子
02230.text:
Exceptional.
[reaction] When you reveal a non-[auto_fail] chaos token, spend 2 resources: Ignore that chaos token and reveal another one to resolve. If that token has a [auto_fail] symbol, remove Lucky Dice from the game (cannot be ignored/canceled).
02230.textZh:
卓越。
[reaction]在你揭示一个非[auto_fail]混乱标记时，花费2资源：忽略该混乱标记，并揭示另一个混乱标记以结算。如果新揭示的标记有[auto_fail]符号，将幸运骰子从游戏中移除(不能忽略/取消)。

02231.name: 机会主义者
02231.text:
Commit only to a skill test you are performing.
If you succeed by 2 or more, return Opportunist to your hand after this test instead of discarding it.
02231.textZh:
只能投入你正在执行的技能检定。
如果你检定成功且超过难度至少2点，在本次检定后不将机会主义者弃掉，改为将其返回你的手牌。

02232.name: 艾丽莎·格雷厄姆
02232.text:
You get +1 [intellect].
[fast] Exhaust Alyssa Graham: Look at the top card of either the encounter deck or any player deck. You may then add 1 doom to Alyssa Graham to place the looked-at card on the bottom of its deck.
02232.textZh:
你得到+1[intellect]。
[free]横置艾丽莎·格雷厄姆：查看遭遇牌库或任意玩家牌库顶的卡牌。然后你可以在艾丽莎·格雷厄姆上增加1个毁灭标记，以将查看的卡牌放到其牌库底。

02233.name: 礼寻术
02233.text:
Uses (3 charges).
[action] Spend 1 charge: Investigate. Investigate using [willpower] instead of [intellect]. You get +2 [willpower] for this test. If successful, you discover 2 additional clues at this location. If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] symbol is revealed during this test, after this test resolves lose all remaining actions and immediately end your turn.
02233.textZh:
使用(3充能)。
[action]花费1充能：调查。本次调查不使用[intellect]，改为使用[willpower]。你本次检定得到+2[willpower]。如果检定成功，你发现所在地点额外2个线索。如果本次检定期间揭示了[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]符号，本次检定结算后，失去所有剩余的行动，立即结束你的回合。

02234.name: 黑马
02234.text:
Limit 1 per investigator.
During the upkeep phase, you may choose to not gain resources.
While you have no resources in your resource pool, you get +1 [willpower], +1 [intellect], +1 [combat], and +1 [agility].
02234.textZh:
每位调查员仅限1张。
在补给阶段期间，你可以选择不获得资源。
你资源池没有资源时，你得到+1[willpower]、+1[intellect]、+1[combat]和+1[agility]。

02235.name: 求生本能
02235.text: If this test is successful during an evasion attempt, the evading investigator may immediately evade each other enemy engaged with him or her, and may move to a connecting location.
02235.textZh: 如果尝试躲避期间本次技能检定成功，躲避的调查员可以立即躲避与其交战的每个其他敌人，并可以移动到一个连接地点。

02260.name: 领导力
02260.text: While Leadership is committed to a skill test being performed by another investigator, Leadership gains [willpower] [wild].
02260.textZh: 领导力投入到另一位调查员执行的技能检定中时，领导力获得[willpower][wild]。

02261.name: “我见过更糟的……”
02261.text:
Fast. Play when you are dealt damage and/or horror.
Cancel up to 5 damage and/or horror just dealt to you. Then, gain that many resources.
02261.textZh:
快速。在你受到伤害和/或恐惧时打出。
取消你刚受到的伤害和/或恐惧中最多5点。然后，获得同等数量的资源。

02262.name: 奇怪的溶液
02262.text:
Researched. Uses (4 supplies).
[action] Spend 1 supply: Heal 2 damage from an investigator at your location.
02262.textZh:
研究完成。使用(4补给)。
[action]花费1补给：治愈你所在地点一位调查员2点伤害。

02263.name: 奇怪的溶液
02263.text:
Researched. Uses (3 supplies).
[action] Spend 1 supply: Fight. Attack with a base [combat] skill of 6. This attack deals +2 damage.
02263.textZh:
研究完成。使用(3补给)。
[action]花费1补给：攻击。以基础值为6的[combat]攻击。本次攻击造成+2伤害。

02264.name: 奇怪的溶液
02264.text:
Researched. Uses (4 supplies).
[action] Spend 1 supply: Evade. Evade with a base [agility] skill of 6.
02264.textZh:
研究完成。使用(4补给)。
[action]花费1补给：躲避。以基础值为6的[agility]躲避。

02265.flavor:
"Murph, you know full well that The Rat would snitch on anyone, at any time, for anything, truth be damned if the price was right."
-Jason Marker, The Worlds of Arkham
02265.flavorZh: “墨菲，你很清楚，只要价格他妈的对路，老鼠能在任何时候，打探到任何人，任何事情。”杰森·马克，《诡镇奇谈的调查员们》
02265.name: 乔伊“老鼠”弗吉尔
02265.text: [fast] Spend 1 resource: Choose an [[Item]] asset from your hand and play it (paying its cost).
02265.textZh: [free]花费1资源：选择你手中的一个[[道具]]支援并将其打出(支付其费用)。
